mounts.description: Normally placid beasts, these intelligent animals form a strong bond with their riders, making them loyal and fearless in battle.

mounts.name: Black War Mammoth
mounts.description: Sure-footed and unflappable, these dark-furred mammoths are prized for their steady temperament going into battle.

mounts.name: Wooly Mammoth
mounts.description: Directly descended from the original progenitor of the mammoth race, wooly mammoths are considered more feral and primal than their shorter-haired cousins.

mounts.name: Wooly Mammoth
mounts.description: This wild variant of the mammoth is not bred for riding. Most wooly mammoths are captured in the wild and tamed by their riders, resulting in a fierce, cunning mount.

mounts.name: Ice Mammoth
mounts.description: The Sons of Hodir believe that riding an ice-white mammoth will protect the rider from frostbite and snow blindness.

mounts.name: Ice Mammoth
mounts.description: Many ice giants claim that they have trained their favored white mammoths to trigger avalanches with their trumpeting calls.

mounts.name: Red Proto-Drake
mounts.description: The vrykul were the first to recognize their potential. Or maybe the second, depending on how you look at it.

mounts.name: Black Proto-Drake
mounts.description: Bred specifically to honor those heroes who showed exceptional resilience and fortitude facing the dangers in Northrend.

mounts.name: Blue Proto-Drake
mounts.description: The Storm Peaks! There we will find the beast strong enough to bear me into battle. -Skadi the Ruthless

mounts.name: Time-Lost Proto-Drake
mounts.description: The only reason for time is so that everything doesn't happen at once.

mounts.name: Plagued Proto-Drake
mounts.description: Bred specifically to honor those heroes who showed significant courage and persistence facing the dangers in Northrend.

mounts.name: Violet Proto-Drake
mounts.description: I cannot help but wonder if things would have turned out different if the titans had elevated even one more dragonflight. -Alexstrasza

mounts.name: Albino Drake
mounts.description: Even the Draconic Native Association tests proved inconclusive in determining if the albino drake is related to a known dragonflight. -Breanni

mounts.name: Armored Brown Bear
mounts.description: This ursine mount's swiftness is enhanced by its heavy armor, imbued with magic from Kirin Tor magi.

mounts.name: Armored Brown Bear
mounts.description: Your cries of "For the Horde!" will be much more menacing from atop a heavily armored bear that's barreling down on Alliance at top speed.

mounts.name: Black War Bear
mounts.description: Killing leaders of the Horde is its own reward, but this intimidating beast is an excellent memento.

mounts.name: Black War Bear
mounts.description: This formidable mount is bought with the blood of Alliance leaders, but you would have killed them for free.

mounts.name: Grand Caravan Mammoth
mounts.description: Merchants trust only this thundering, mountainous steed to protect them when venturing down Azeroth's most dangerous trade routes.

mounts.name: Grand Caravan Mammoth
mounts.description: A common sight on trade routes all across Azeroth, this calm, stalwart mount is the favorite of merchants traveling to exotic and distant markets.

mounts.name: Mekgineer's Chopper
mounts.description: Sporting superb engineering craftsmanship, this chopper is one of the few personal vehicles on Azeroth built for two.

mounts.name: Armored Snowy Gryphon
mounts.description: The nice thing is that when they attack, blood almost never stains their feathers. -Mei Francis

mounts.name: Armored Blue Wind Rider
mounts.description: They are not native to Northrend, but they have adapted extremely well to the cold. -Mei Francis

mounts.name: Green Proto-Drake
mounts.description: The vrykul were the first to recognize their potential. Or maybe the second, depending on how you look at it.

mounts.name: Magnificent Flying Carpet
mounts.description: Standard features include a sturdy imbued frostweave frame and real iceweb spider silk threading.  Spare head pillow sold separately.

mounts.name: Traveler's Tundra Mammoth
mounts.description: Ancient manuscripts depict merchants traveling across the frozen tundra with these colossal beasts, leading scholars to believe they are the first domesticated mounts.

mounts.name: Traveler's Tundra Mammoth
mounts.description: Riders and merchants alike trust only this strong and steadfast mammoth to carry them safely across the frigid tundra.

mounts.name: Flying Carpet
mounts.description: Hop aboard this flying carpet to see the shining, shimmering, and splendid world of Azeroth, wonder by wonder.

mounts.name: Grand Black War Mammoth
mounts.description: Once used by giants to carry heavily armored warriors, these grand war mammoths can easily bear more than one rider of less-than-giant stature.

mounts.name: Grand Black War Mammoth
mounts.description: Rarely, a war mammoth is born stronger and more tractable than its peers. These mammoths are dubbed "grand" and carry more than one rider to the front lines.

mounts.name: Grand Ice Mammoth
mounts.description: At home on the narrow, icy trails of the Storm Peaks, these mammoths are the only mounts the ice giants trust to carry large loads and multiple riders.

mounts.name: Grand Ice Mammoth
mounts.description: Due to high winds and avalanches, the Sons of Hodir recommend bringing at least two companions if venturing into the dangerous Storm Peaks.

mounts.name: Blue Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Dragonhawks are among the deadliest known predators. They are able to spot prey from great distances, rush in, and rend with both talon and beak.

mounts.name: Red Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Dragonhawks are among the deadliest known predators. They are able to spot prey from great distances, rush in, and rend with both talon and beak.

mounts.name: Illidari Doomhawk
mounts.description: Once a year, a rift in time appears, and strange things occur. The Illidari scouts and Doomwalker were quite surprised to find themselves in Tanaris.

mounts.name: Stormwind Steed
mounts.description: Although raised in Stormwind, this breed showed unusual aptitude for the cold weather in Icecrown.

mounts.name: Darkspear Raptor
mounts.description: This raptor breed was originally cultivated by the Drakkari, but has since been adopted by the Darkspear tribe in Northrend.

mounts.name: Ironforge Ram
mounts.description: Wildhammer Fact Checker claims that this specific breed was the first type of ram domesticated by the dwarves when they settled in Dun Morogh.

mounts.name: Darnassian Nightsaber
mounts.description: When a night elf's mount perishes, it is custom for the rider to keep one of the saber's great fangs as a token of remembrance.

mounts.name: Gnomeregan Mechanostrider
mounts.description: When you absolutely, positively have to be there right now. -Rillie Spindlenut

mounts.name: Exodar Elekk
mounts.description: Exodar Elekk are elekk which have been anointed by O'ros, the Naaru who journeyed from Draenor to Azeroth with Velen and his followers.

mounts.name: Orgrimmar Wolf
mounts.description: For a brief time, many orcs would declare themselves "hungry like an Orgrimmar wolf." Some blood elves still use the phrase ironically.

mounts.name: Thunder Bluff Kodo
mounts.description: An alpha member of the herd, this kodo is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through Mulgore.

mounts.name: Silvermoon Hawkstrider
mounts.description: So I says I feel like chicken tonight. Next thing, I am flat out and that thing is trying to see what my eyes taste like. -Bozzle Blastbolt

mounts.name: Forsaken Warhorse
mounts.description: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Mimiron's Head
mounts.description: A token of titan craftsmanship hoarded by the Old God, Yogg-Saron. Currently the single largest mechanical gnome head in Azeroth.

mounts.name: Argent Hippogryph
mounts.description: Argent Hippogryphs will partner with only the bravest and most battle-tested champions.

mounts.name: Ironbound Proto-Drake
mounts.description: His skin more hard than brass was found, that sword nor spear could pierce nor wound.

mounts.name: Rusted Proto-Drake
mounts.description: Not as shiny as the other one, but it's still a great find lads. Brann Bronzebeard

mounts.name: Blue Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.description: A rare sight. Most disappeared once Baron Rivendare ruled in Stratholme.

mounts.name: White Kodo
mounts.description: "The kodo is the backbone of our people. Wherever the Horde goes - in trade, settlement, or war - there you will find the mighty kodo." - Harb Clawhoof

mounts.name: Black Wolf
mounts.description: Can howl loudly enough to be heard for miles.

mounts.name: Venomhide Ravasaur
mounts.description: You raised this thing from a scaly pup - Mor'vek would be so proud. But he'd still make you clean up the mess it made in the corner.

mounts.name: Sea Turtle
mounts.description: Often caught by fishermen at a young age, these mounts are much more comfortable in the water than they are on land.

mounts.name: Deadly Gladiator's Frost Wyrm
mounts.description: These reanimated vessels of destruction do not fear death; they dispense it.

mounts.name: Black Skeletal Horse
mounts.description: The Forsaken believe that without a purpose, even beasts of burden suffer in undeath.

mounts.name: Furious Gladiator's Frost Wyrm
mounts.description: Some of Azeroth's mightiest dragons have been summoned across the veil between life and death to serve new masters with undying loyalty.

mounts.name: Great Red Elekk
mounts.description: Never seen in Nagrand, the first red elekk calves were born in Azeroth after the Exodar's arrival. Some breeders theorize that the unique coloration is somehow caused by the same radiation which ravaged Bloodmyst Isle.

mounts.name: Swift Moonsaber
mounts.description: Many night elves revere these proud mounts because their shimmering coats symbolize the goddess of the moon, Elune.

mounts.name: Swift Red Hawkstrider
mounts.description: What do you mean is it dyed? Oh, the bird. We did touch up the red just a little. -Trellis Morningsun

mounts.name: Swift Gray Steed
mounts.description: A veteran of some of the toughest battles fought by the Argent Crusade.

mounts.name: Great Golden Kodo
mounts.description: An alpha member of the herd, this kodo is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through the Southern Barrens.

mounts.name: Turbostrider
mounts.description: The mirror's not so you can look back, but so your foes can see something besides your tailpipes. -Rillie Spindlenut

mounts.name: Swift Violet Ram
mounts.description: The Barak Tor'ol ram's thick bony skull and massive horns make it the ideal mount for charging through groups of armored enemies.

mounts.name: Swift Purple Raptor
mounts.description: Longtime allies of the trolls, these jungle hunters form a special bond with their masters. They become mount, guardian, and friend.

mounts.name: White Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.description: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Swift Burgundy Wolf
mounts.description: The wolves of the Horde are befriended, not domesticated.

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.description: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Silver Covenant Hippogryph
mounts.description: Silver Covenant Hippogryphs are fiercely loyal, both to their riding partners, and to the Alliance.

mounts.name: Sunreaver Dragonhawk
mounts.description: The Sunreavers of Dalaran select only the swiftest and most formidable of dragonhawks as their mounts.

mounts.name: Quel'dorei Steed
mounts.description: Comes from a lineage of fine horses that once grazed near the shores of the Well of Eternity.

mounts.name: Sunreaver Hawkstrider
mounts.description: I demand speed, grace and discipline on the battlefield. This one will serve nicely. -Eressea Dawnsinger

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.description: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.description: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.description: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Ochre Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.description: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Striped Dawnsaber
mounts.description: Night elves once believed that seeing this light colored saber breed in the wild was an ill omen.

mounts.name: Argent Charger
mounts.description: Trained to accept only champions of the Light as a rider.

mounts.name: Relentless Gladiator's Frost Wyrm
mounts.description: In life, it could not be tamed, but necromancy and esoteric binding rituals have now combined to bend this indomitable creature to its rider's will.

mounts.name: Argent Warhorse
mounts.description: Given only to those who prove themselves a champion in the Argent Tournament.

mounts.name: Swift Horde Wolf
mounts.description: A few of the Argent Crusade's swiftest mounts were awarded to those members of the Horde who performed exceptionally during the tournament in Icecrown.

mounts.name: Swift Alliance Steed
mounts.description: A few of the Argent Crusade's swiftest mounts were awarded to those members of the Alliance who performed exceptionally during the tournament in Icecrown.

mounts.name: Crusader's White Warhorse
mounts.description: Awarded to only the most skilled champions from the Trial of the Crusader, these steeds were chosen for Alliance members from Tirion Fordring's own personal stable.

mounts.name: Crusader's Black Warhorse
mounts.description: Awarded to only the most skilled champions from the Trial of the Crusader, these steeds were chosen for Horde members from Tirion Fordring's own personal stable.

mounts.name: Onyxian Drake
mounts.description: She has a lot in common with her mother, except for the being killed and reanimated. But she is young still. -Maloriak

mounts.name: Sunwalker Kodo
mounts.description: This magnificent beast, adorned in sacred charms and painted with holy imagery, radiates with the warmth of the sun.

mounts.name: Great Sunwalker Kodo
mounts.description: At daybreak, the noble Sunwalkers often perform rituals to bless their mounts, imbuing them with holy magic.

mounts.name: X-45 Heartbreaker
mounts.description: Apothecary Hummel painted this masterpiece bright pink for an unrequited love.

mounts.name: Wrathful Gladiator's Frost Wyrm
mounts.description: Many believe that during their early lives, these wyrms were forced to fight their own kind for the amusement of others. Perhaps that is why they possess a particularly combative temperament.

mounts.name: Invincible
mounts.description: The famous steed of Arthas Menethil, who serves its master in life and in death.  Riding him is truly a feat of strength.

mounts.name: Icebound Frostbrood Vanquisher
mounts.description: Raised from the chilling depths of Icecrown, Frostbrood Vanquishers are considered among the fiercest and most relentless of all frost wyrms.

mounts.name: Bloodbathed Frostbrood Vanquisher
mounts.description: Bloodbathed Vanquishers are so named when it is determined that a reanimated frost wyrm died a particularly gruesome and bloody death.

mounts.name: Crimson Deathcharger
mounts.description: Stabled in the Icecrown Citadel to serve the Lich King's most favored minions.

mounts.name: Exarch's Elekk
mounts.description: Draenei exarchs have long marched into war atop these imposing mounts, bred for their razor-sharp tusks.

mounts.name: Great Exarch's Elekk
mounts.description: Only the most distinguished paladins are given the honor of riding this elekk. Its plated armor and purple adornments have been blessed by Prophet Velen himself.

mounts.name: Blazing Hippogryph
mounts.description: Hippogryphs are highly intelligent, sentient beings; far more than mere "mounts."

mounts.name: Wooly White Rhino
mounts.description: Captured by Toby "Mother Goose" Ironbolt on the Borean Tundra, this shaggy beast carries an enormous grudge after being bridled by a gnome.

mounts.name: Vashj'ir Seahorse
mounts.description: Stubborn until broken, these underwater mounts provide the swiftest means of travel around the depths of Vashj'ir.

mounts.name: Frosty Flying Carpet
mounts.description: "I remember my first flying carpet... yeti hair and burlap.  Not nearly as nice as this one here." - Frozo the Renowned

mounts.name: Celestial Steed
mounts.description: A beacon of hope; a guiding light in the darkness.

mounts.name: X-53 Touring Rocket
mounts.description: Riding a giant cylinder filled with highly explosive goblin rocket fuel all by yourself is just crazy...so bring a friend.

mounts.name: Fossilized Raptor
mounts.description: Legends tell of a spell placed upon a hunting raptor who dared to snarl at young Tyrande Whisperwind as she bathed in a jungle pool. The beast is cursed to wander Azeroth -  until it apologizes.

mounts.name: Goblin Trike
mounts.description: A compilation of nuts, bolts, gears, and treated wood paneling make for an unusually smooth ride.

mounts.name: Goblin Turbo-Trike
mounts.description: The turbo trike's tri-wheel design adds superior stability and a smaller turn radius over its two wheeled cousins.

mounts.name: Volcanic Stone Drake
mounts.description: Fire can transform stone in exciting ways, but never let the Stonemother know I said that. -Earthcaller Yevaa

mounts.name: Drake of the East Wind
mounts.description: In Deathwing's mad quest to forge new dragons, he ignored amazing breeds never before seen on Azeroth. -Thrall

mounts.name: Phosphorescent Stone Drake
mounts.description: The Stonemother has shown little concern for the rebellious Aeonaxx, even allowing his spawn to be taken from her realm.

mounts.name: Drake of the West Wind
mounts.description: Harnessing the elemental powers of the storm, these majestic beasts crackle like lightning and roar like thunder.

mounts.name: Drake of the North Wind
mounts.description: They sicken of the calm who know the storm.

mounts.name: Drake of the South Wind
mounts.description: Gentle as a summer breeze, but that says little considering where it came from. -Itesh

mounts.name: Vitreous Stone Drake
mounts.description: Those would be perfect in a pendant, and that would make a fantastic ring. Let me know if this thing sheds or molts or whatever. -Kalinda

mounts.name: Brown Riding Camel
mounts.description: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: Tan Riding Camel
mounts.description: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: Grey Riding Camel
mounts.description: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: Dark Phoenix
mounts.description: Despite their name, Dark Phoenixes are known to have a warm and cheerful disposition.

mounts.name: Golden King
mounts.description: Don't let the saddle fool you, he's wild, not a tame lion.

mounts.name: Ultramarine Qiraji Battle Tank
mounts.description: The Tol'vir sorcerer Azj'Aqir was said to possess a scepter that would allow him to control a Qiraj battle tank outside of its Silithus home.

mounts.name: Spectral Steed
mounts.description: Dark spirits flee before the radiance of its presence.

mounts.name: Spectral Wolf
mounts.description: Fears only fire.

mounts.name: Sandstone Drake
mounts.description: Sandstone Drakes were studied in great detail long ago by the famed alchemist Walleye Sprysprocket. It has even been said that Walleye developed potions to mimic the drakes' physiology.

mounts.name: Mottled Drake
mounts.description: I thought the thing was ill until it took to the air. It flies as true as any of my own. -Alexstrasza

mounts.name: Kor'kron Annihilator
mounts.description: Vicious in battle and surprisingly loyal, this battle scorpion serves only those who show true commitment to a powerful guild.

mounts.name: Armored Razzashi Raptor
mounts.description: The purebred royal raptors of Zul'Gurub, these mounts have become a rare sight in Stranglethorn Vale. The Gurubashi have been known to fly into a rage at the sight of any non-troll riding one of their precious beasts.

mounts.name: Swift Zulian Panther
mounts.description: The jungle trolls have long coveted panther fangs, using them for rituals or as ingredients in mojos.

mounts.name: Amani Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Dragonhawks liberated from troll enslavement are considered among the most loyal of all their kin.

mounts.name: Flameward Hippogryph
mounts.description: Flameward Hippogryphs revel in the defeat of Ragnaros, Lord of Fire.

mounts.name: Pureblood Fire Hawk
mounts.description: Legends state that the Pureblood line may be traced back to the very creation of the Firelands.

mounts.name: Felfire Hawk
mounts.description: Felfire is deadly to the touch.  Luckily, the hawk can suppress the flames, choosing not to incinerate its rider in an emerald effigy.

mounts.name: Corrupted Fire Hawk
mounts.description: Millagazor was a fire hawk loyal to Ragnaros. At this time it is unknown how many of Millagazor's eggs were corrupted.

mounts.name: Savage Raptor
mounts.description: One-time companion of Kanga the Primal, the fallen troll hero. The raptor's name is unknown, for Kanga only spoke to it in bear form.

mounts.name: Amani Battle Bear
mounts.description: The Amani trolls decorate these ferocious mounts in magic amulets and ceremonial masks as a way to venerate the bear god Nalorakk.

mounts.name: Subdued Seahorse
mounts.description: "One has not truly lived until they have felt the tidal current rushing through their hair while atop a majestic seahorse," said no one.  Ever.

mounts.name: Winged Guardian
mounts.description: Unearthed recently in an ancient tomb, this mighty winged lion may have once served one of the ancient Tol'vir princes.

mounts.name: Vicious War Steed
mounts.description: Armored to withstand collisions in battle.

mounts.name: Vicious War Wolf
mounts.description: At Warchief Hellscream's command, Horde trainers began raising wolves to thrive in the shock and ferocity of sustained combat.

mounts.name: Vicious Gladiator's Twilight Drake
mounts.description: Heroes who proved their might in the gladiatorial arenas during the Cataclysm were awarded the most exceptional of the twilight drake broods.

mounts.name: Flametalon of Alysrazor
mounts.description: As with their matriarch, Alysrazor, the fury and fervor of these elemental avians are unquenchable.

mounts.name: Swift Shorestrider
mounts.description: A rarity amongst the tallstrider breeds of Kalimdor, but easily recognized by its pungent dead seaweed aroma.

mounts.name: Ruthless Gladiator's Twilight Drake
mounts.description: Heroes who proved their might in the gladiatorial arenas during the Cataclysm were awarded the most exceptional of the twilight drake broods.

mounts.name: Swift Forest Strider
mounts.description: This vibrant breed can only be found in the forests of Darkmoon Island.

mounts.name: Swift Springstrider
mounts.description: The joys of Noblegarden are best when celebrated with this loyal, loving, and blandly-colored freak of nature.

mounts.name: Swift Lovebird
mounts.description: It's like red but not quite.

mounts.name: White Riding Camel
mounts.description: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: Corrupted Hippogryph
mounts.description: It is a sad fact that even the wise and majestic hippogryph may fall prey to corruption.

mounts.name: Darkmoon Dancing Bear
mounts.description: These fearsome mounts have a habit of suddenly breaking out into dance amid battle, much to the annoyance of their riders.

mounts.name: Mountain Horse
mounts.description: Images of this breed are often found on kegs of watered-down dwarven brew.

mounts.name: Swift Mountain Horse
mounts.description: Longs for the day it may return to its home in Gilneas.

mounts.name: Tyrael's Charger
mounts.description: A symbol of justice throughout all known realms.

mounts.name: Spectral Gryphon
mounts.description: When you said an old friend was coming back, this was not quite what I expected. -Bralla Cloudwing

mounts.name: Spectral Wind Rider
mounts.description: How do you not fall right through that thing? -Maztha

mounts.name: Blazing Drake
mounts.description: Blazing Drakes exhibit a boundless passion for life, and are considered by many to be among the most loyal mounts on Azeroth.

mounts.name: Twilight Harbinger
mounts.description: Whatever dark magic once compelled the Twilight Harbinger is now broken... or is it?

mounts.name: Life-Binder's Handmaiden
mounts.description: Alexstrasza, the former dragon Aspect of Life, is known to be a kind and patient mentor. Under her tutelage, only the most dedicated pupils acquire the title of "Life-Binder's Handmaiden."

mounts.name: Experiment 12-B
mounts.description: Some believe Experiment 12-B is the result of a covert SI-7 initiative, others consider it the outcome of embyronic tinkering by goblin scientists. No matter the case, this much is certain: given its strength, speed and agility, Experiment 12-B was a success!

mounts.name: Heart of the Aspects
mounts.description: You are Azeroth's true guardians and the future of this world is in your hands, for the dawning of the age of mortals has begun. - Alexstrasza

mounts.name: Feldrake
mounts.description: Fighting the Burning Legion millennia ago, this valiant drake fell to corruption after its body was infused with raw demonic magic.

mounts.name: Jade Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Jade Cloud Serpents are light and agile; quick and deadly.

mounts.name: Azure Water Strider
mounts.description: "Normally bugs are for bait, but how could you look into its eyes and even think that?" -Nat Pagle

mounts.name: Pandaren Kite
mounts.description: This "mount," awarded by the Lorewalkers of Pandaria, is a reward to the hero of their organization.

mounts.name: Jeweled Onyx Panther
mounts.description: Trade Prince Gallywix recently ordered dozens of these glittering jewel-encrusted mounts to roam the grounds of his pleasure palace.

mounts.name: Green Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Great Red Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat."  - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Cindermane Charger
mounts.description: Formed by Ragnaros himself as a gift for the daughter he never had.

mounts.name: Obsidian Nightwing
mounts.description: When you can't run, you crawl, and when you can't crawl you find someone to carry you.

mounts.name: Sapphire Panther
mounts.description: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Jade Panther
mounts.description: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Ruby Panther
mounts.description: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Sunstone Panther
mounts.description: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Grand Expedition Yak
mounts.description: These beasts of burden are known to carry over five times their own weight and to be capable of lasting several days without food or water.

mounts.name: Kafa Yak
mounts.description: It's unclear whether grummles named this yak after its color or purpose.

mounts.name: Amber Scorpion
mounts.description: The Klaxxi ride massive scorpions into battle against their enemies.  A carapace hardened by amber provides superior protection while on the battlefield.

mounts.name: Azure Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Azure Cloud Serpents are believed by the Pandaren to be harbingers of good fortune.

mounts.name: Golden Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Golden Cloud Serpents are a treasure to be enjoyed by all who visit the continent of Pandaria.

mounts.name: Thundering Jade Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.

mounts.name: Cataclysmic Gladiator's Twilight Drake
mounts.description: Heroes who proved their might in the gladiatorial arenas during the Cataclysm were awarded the most exceptional of the twilight drake broods.

mounts.name: Imperial Quilen
mounts.description: Favorite pets of the ancient Mogu princes, Quilen make loyal and fearless companions and mounts.

mounts.name: Depleted-Kyparium Rocket
mounts.description: When Kyparite is depleted of its amber essence it becomes fairly resistant to the corrosion from rocket fuel.

mounts.name: Geosynchronous World Spinner
mounts.description: This rocket was originally designed to speed up the rotation of the world making for shorter nights.  Gnomes with insomnia can have lofty goals.

mounts.name: Onyx Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Onyx Cloud serpents are known to be more aggressive and daring than their cousins, the Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpents.

mounts.name: Crimson Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Crimson Cloud Serpents are given to flights of fancy, striking out on a whim for seemingly random journeys, sometimes for days at a time.

mounts.name: Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpents are born with violet scales covering the entirety of their body. Over time, these scales darken to the color of onyx.

mounts.name: Heavenly Crimson Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Heavenly Crimson Cloud Serpents are considered to be among the noblest of dragons.

mounts.name: Heavenly Golden Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Warmth and hope emanate from this great creature, which glows like a sunrise over the mountains.

mounts.name: Yu'lei, Daughter of Jade
mounts.description: Warmth and wisdom emanate from this great creature, which glows like moonlight passing through the finest jade.

mounts.name: Heavenly Azure Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Warmth and serenity emanate from this great creature, which glows like the cloudless sky of a summer afternoon.

mounts.name: Astral Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: It is believed that Astral Cloud Serpents possess answers to some of life's greatest mysteries. Pity they can't talk.

mounts.name: Azure Riding Crane
mounts.description: The majestic crane is a treasured friend of the pandaren.

mounts.name: Golden Riding Crane
mounts.description: The crane is a symbol of wisdom and nobility, their ability to carry us into the skies is nothing short of miraculous. - Jaluu the Generous

mounts.name: Regal Riding Crane
mounts.description: The crane is a symbol of wisdom and nobility. Their ability to carry us into the skies is nothing short of miraculous. - Jaluu the Generous

mounts.name: Jungle Riding Crane
mounts.description: A beloved mount in southern Pandaria, the jungle crane is known for its speed and agility honed over a lifetime of avoiding Krasari tigers.

mounts.name: Black Riding Yak
mounts.description: Grummles traveling Kun-Lai Summit by night prefer to ride this dark-haired yak to remain unseen, though they remove the bells from its caparison first.

mounts.name: Modest Expedition Yak
mounts.description: Unlike its burden-bearing kin, this yak prefers to travel light and go no more than a mile at a time.

mounts.name: Grey Riding Yak
mounts.description: Riding Yaks are bred to be slimmer and more agile than their kin.

mounts.name: Blonde Riding Yak
mounts.description: Riding Yaks are bred to be slimmer and more agile than their kin.

mounts.name: Crimson Water Strider
mounts.description: "Normally bugs are for bait, but how could you look into its eyes and even think that?" -Nat Pagle

mounts.name: Black Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Blue Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Brown Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Purple Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Red Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Great Green Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat."  - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Black Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat."  - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Blue Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat."  - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Brown Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat."  - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Purple Dragon Turtle
mounts.description: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat."  - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Crimson Pandaren Phoenix
mounts.description: The plumage of the Crimson Phoenix is said to represent prosperity and happiness.

mounts.name: Thundering August Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.

mounts.name: Green Shado-Pan Riding Tiger
mounts.description: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Blue Shado-Pan Riding Tiger
mounts.description: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Red Shado-Pan Riding Tiger
mounts.description: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Brown Riding Goat
mounts.description: It takes unflagging patience and a gentle touch to train obstinate mountain goats for riding.

mounts.name: Red Flying Cloud
mounts.description: An ancient mogu artifact awarded to those who are deeply committed to the discovery and sharing of Pandaren lore.

mounts.name: White Riding Goat
mounts.description: It takes unflagging patience and a gentle touch to train obstinate mountain goats for riding.

mounts.name: Black Riding Goat
mounts.description: It takes unflagging patience and a gentle touch to train obstinate mountain goats for riding.

mounts.name: Son of Galleon
mounts.description: Trained from a young age, these massive Mushan are taught to thunder into battle carrying a full saurok warband.

mounts.name: Pandaren Kite
mounts.description: This token of honor is a gift from the Lorewalkers of Pandaria. Flying manual seemingly not included, however.

mounts.name: Thundering Ruby Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.

mounts.name: Ashen Pandaren Phoenix
mounts.description: Both the name and color of this majestic phoenix are believed to symbolize rebirth.

mounts.name: Emerald Pandaren Phoenix
mounts.description: The colors of this rare phoenix's plumage are said to bring great fortune.

mounts.name: Violet Pandaren Phoenix
mounts.description: The Violet Phoenix's plumage is said to symbolize a union of opposing forces.

mounts.name: Jade Pandaren Kite
mounts.description: The residents of Pandaria salute your enthusiasm for wildlife preservation. They do have concerns about housing 150 animals per visit, though.

mounts.name: Sky Golem
mounts.description: A glorious feat of engineering, the sky golem takes traditional shredder technology to a whole new level (and altitude!).

mounts.name: Swift Windsteed
mounts.description: One of Pandaria's most elusive creatures, said to bring good fortune to its rider.

mounts.name: Grand Armored Gryphon
mounts.description: This noble gryphon is as staunch a battle companion as any member of the Alliance could ask for.

mounts.name: Grand Armored Wyvern
mounts.description: This ferocious beast, renowned among wyvern handlers, was one of the first mounts chosen to take part in the Horde's Dominance Offensive.

mounts.name: Grand Gryphon
mounts.description: Gryphons' keen eyesight allows them to see over vast distances and warn their riders of any dangers that lie ahead.

mounts.name: Grand Wyvern
mounts.description: Wyverns hail from some of the most inhospitable regions of Kalimdor, making them masters of adapting to any environment.

mounts.name: Armored Skyscreamer
mounts.description: Only those heroic souls who surmount every challenge the mogu tyrants place before them can proudly fly the skies on a war-prepared skyscreamer.

mounts.name: Spawn of Horridon
mounts.description: When you see a hurricane coming, you get out of the way. Horridon would fight the hurricane and win.

mounts.name: Ghastly Charger
mounts.description: Not all of Medivh's victims are gone for good.

mounts.name: Cobalt Primordial Direhorn
mounts.description: "When ya fight alongside raptors, ya want a mount dey can't eat." -Unknown dinomancer

mounts.name: Amber Primordial Direhorn
mounts.description: There is an old Zandalari saying about wild direhorns: "Run!"

mounts.name: Slate Primordial Direhorn
mounts.description: The masks aren't to control the direhorn; they are so no one sees your face when it turns on you.

mounts.name: Jade Primordial Direhorn
mounts.description: The festive coloring belies deadly intent.

mounts.name: Bone-White Primal Raptor
mounts.description: "They are lethal at eight months, very lethal." -Hemet Nesingwary Jr.

mounts.name: Red Primal Raptor
mounts.description: Raptors have spread to nearly all of the lands of Azeroth. It is uncertain whether the trolls led them or followed them.

mounts.name: Black Primal Raptor
mounts.description: Speed, cunning, and ferocity are the things trolls and raptors admire about each other.

mounts.name: Green Primal Raptor
mounts.description: "Raptors are as loyal as they are vicious. If you ain't friend, you are food." -Kijara

mounts.name: Malevolent Gladiator's Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: These cloud serpents have scales that... are the color of clouds, actually.

mounts.name: Thundering Cobalt Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: This is a descendant of the irascible Nalak. Lightning erupts from its scales and arcs over the saddle. Dare you sit?

mounts.name: Clutch of Ji-Kun
mounts.description: Although Ji-Kun feasted on the failed creations of mogu flesh-shapers, her progeny is willing to eat more pedestrian carcasses.

mounts.name: Armored Bloodwing
mounts.description: This monstrous, flesh-eating bat is the undisputed ruler of the night skies.

mounts.name: Golden Primal Direhorn
mounts.description: Sharp at both ends and crafty in the middle. Leave it to the trolls to think this was a good idea.

mounts.name: Crimson Primal Direhorn
mounts.description: Leave it to the blood elves to pick the red one.

mounts.name: Hearthsteed
mounts.description: Each step echoes with the rage of your three opponents.

mounts.name: Armored Red Dragonhawk
mounts.description: This rare breed of dragonhawk is a mark of honor in the Horde, gifted by the blood elves. It reflects your tireless effort to amass a small army of mounts.

mounts.name: Armored Blue Dragonhawk
mounts.description: After you amassed a massive menagerie of 200 mounts, the animal authorities of the Alliance sent you a means to keep them in line (and out of their hair).

mounts.name: Brawler's Burly Mushan Beast
mounts.description: For years pandaren believed these creatures to be untamable. Just ask the first pandaren to do so, Henshi "Limp Along" Homebrew.

mounts.name: Enchanted Fey Dragon
mounts.description: This majestic creature is Brightwing's older brother. He affirms that she was, in fact, adopted.

mounts.name: Ironbound Wraithcharger
mounts.description: Its ethereal spirit is barely contained by its iron shell. The penultimate creation of Salanar the Horseman, these powerful steeds were once thought to have all been destroyed.

mounts.name: Vicious Kaldorei Warsaber
mounts.description: The blades adorning this mount's armor are designed to both inspire fear and pre-slice meals for the warsaber.

mounts.name: Vicious Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.description: Only rewarded to those who have bested their foes in battle.

mounts.name: Spawn of Galakras
mounts.description: This formidable creature's lineage may be traced to Galakras, and yet further to Galakrond, one of the most infamous of all proto-dragons.

mounts.name: Kor'kron War Wolf
mounts.description: The Kor'kron use only the mightiest wolves for their mounts, bedecking them in armor that would break the backs of lesser creatures.

mounts.name: Kor'kron Juggernaut
mounts.description: The Kor'kron Juggernaut is a weapon of unbridled destruction, born from the mind of Garrosh Hellscream and made real by his engineers.

mounts.name: Ashhide Mushan Beast
mounts.description: Some people say that riding an ashhide mushan will result in favorable health and increased prosperity. These people are called "mount vendors."

mounts.name: Thundering Onyx Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: This ebony cloud serpent is a lightning-wreathed vision of such rarity as to have driven many mortals to madness.

mounts.name: Tyrannical Gladiator's Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: These cloud serpents always look elegant and slim in classic black.

mounts.name: Grievous Gladiator's Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: These brilliantly colored cloud serpents have scales that are a mixture of ruby, gold, and nearly violet.

mounts.name: Prideful Gladiator's Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: These brilliantly colored cloud serpents have scales that range from gold to pink. Or we could call it coral.

mounts.name: Emerald Hippogryph
mounts.description: These majestic animals come in various colorings, but the emerald variety can only be tamed by the magic of friendship.

mounts.name: Iron Skyreaver
mounts.description: Iron Horde beastmasters bred this rylak for war and then girded it for battle in black steel and smoldering flame.

mounts.name: Warforged Nightmare
mounts.description: A nightmarish steed of hardened steel and vengeful spirits, this companion will follow you to the depths of the Firelands and back without complaint.

mounts.name: Grinning Reaver
mounts.description: The difference between a smile and a grin is the difference between a kiss and tasting.

mounts.name: Dread Raven
mounts.description: Filled with the hatred of an ancient god, the dread raven are the Arakkoa's most trusted guardians.

mounts.name: Creeping Carpet
mounts.description: Can't fly, but can creep very quickly.

mounts.name: Core Hound
mounts.description: Molten to the core!

mounts.name: Gorestrider Gronnling
mounts.description: Once "befriended", a gronnling will happily carry its rider to their death.

mounts.name: Witherhide Cliffstomper
mounts.description: Tiny notches cover the hooves of this variation of clefthoof, allowing it to safely scale mountainous regions in search of food.

mounts.name: Trained Icehoof
mounts.description: It wasn't until you owned this mount that you understood how much the world of Draenor would test you. Clefthoof hair gets in everything!

mounts.name: Tundra Icehoof
mounts.description: A translucent layer of down hair covers this breed's leathery hide, acting as the perfect insulation for cold environments.

mounts.name: Bloodhoof Bull
mounts.description: Members of the Warsong clan have long hunted these clefthoof to use their crimson-hued skin for battle standards.

mounts.name: Ironhoof Destroyer
mounts.description: Blackhand is said to have personally designed the fiery armaments used on the Iron Horde's clefthoof battle mounts.

mounts.name: Mottled Meadowstomper
mounts.description: The elekk's long trunk allows it to sniff out sources of food, avoid danger, and steal snacks from your bags when you're not looking.

mounts.name: Trained Meadowstomper
mounts.description: The draenei perfected elekk husbandry long ago, adorning the creatures with Light-infused crystals to make them more docile.

mounts.name: Shadowhide Pearltusk
mounts.description: Some legends say the draenei first befriended the elekk after one of the beasts saved an injured scout from a pack of vicious podlings.

mounts.name: Dusty Rockhide
mounts.description: Ever since acquiring this mount, you have been plagued by strange fever dreams of hippety-hoppety clippety-cloppety elekk on parade.

mounts.name: Armored Irontusk
mounts.description: It is said an elekk never forgets. No wonder it despises the Iron Horde, considering the torment the orcs put the beast through.

mounts.name: Blacksteel Battleboar
mounts.description: Refuses to run unless its head is covered in heavy, spiked metal. It's an ego thing.

mounts.name: Rocktusk Battleboar
mounts.description: It's not the metal helmet that attracts mates; it's the sweet mohawk.

mounts.name: Armored Frostboar
mounts.description: Subsists almost entirely on a diet of frozen berries. Though it finds slow off-worlders equally tasty.

mounts.name: Armored Razorback
mounts.description: Never... ever... EVER... let it smell bacon on you.

mounts.name: Frostplains Battleboar
mounts.description: If it didn't have the cool tusk ring, it would feel so silly in that outfit.

mounts.name: Wild Goretusk
mounts.description: If you want a gentle ride, go find a "tame happytusk" or something.

mounts.name: Domesticated Razorback
mounts.description: "Domesticated" does not mean "friendly." Bring some treats.

mounts.name: Giant Coldsnout
mounts.description: Its snout is not just cold but wet. Not a pleasant way to wake up.

mounts.name: Great Greytusk
mounts.description: Sheds its tusks once a year. Is extremely shy until they grow back.

mounts.name: Trained Rocktusk
mounts.description: Thoroughly trained in how to snort, trot, and stomp on the faces of its enemies.

mounts.name: Trained Riverwallow
mounts.description: Riverwallows are one of the heartiest beasts on Draenor, resulting in their increased stamina and distinctive coloring.

mounts.name: Sapphire Riverbeast
mounts.description: This animal's color mimics the clear blue of Draenor's river shallows, making it almost invisible to aquatic predators.

mounts.name: Mudback Riverbeast
mounts.description: Special webbing that grows on the soles of the mudback's feet gives them extra traction in mud and slick terrain.

mounts.name: Mosshide Riverwallow
mounts.description: Aggressive and territorial, the mosshide is known for hiding in river-shore scrub and ambushing unwary passersby.

mounts.name: Hellfire Infernal
mounts.description: From the bowels of the nether is summoned a creature of pure hatred, bent on burning down any life in its way.

mounts.name: Solar Spirehawk
mounts.description: Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into the heart of the sun. Goggles are recommended when you're riding.

mounts.name: Shadowmane Charger
mounts.description: Draenei poets have likened this talbuk's coloring to shadows cast by moonlight in an ashen forest.

mounts.name: Swift Breezestrider
mounts.description: Draenei have relied on this mount, the swiftest of all talbuk, to relay messengers and their missives safely to their destinations.

mounts.name: Trained Silverpelt
mounts.description: Prized for its intelligence, this breed of talbuk can be trained to execute defensive kicks and gorings in battle.

mounts.name: Breezestrider Stallion
mounts.description: These breezestriders' red coloration reflects their temperament: sanguine, fierce, and courageous.

mounts.name: Pale Thorngrazer
mounts.description: This talbuk subsists completely on a diet of thistles and thorns, making its insides as tough as its outside.

mounts.name: Vicious War Ram
mounts.description: Until it head-butts you below the belt, it has not truly accepted you as its rider.

mounts.name: Vicious War Raptor
mounts.description: Because sharp teeth and claws weren't enough.

mounts.name: Garn Steelmaw
mounts.description: A trainer once tried to put decorative metal in his steelmaw wolf's mouth. He had to wait three days to get it back.

mounts.name: Warsong Direfang
mounts.description: Has a will of iron but is a sweetheart if you give it a clefthoof bone to chew on.

mounts.name: Armored Frostwolf
mounts.description: It's trained to survive the harsh climate of Frostfire Ridge, so it snuggles as if its life depended on it.

mounts.name: Ironside Warwolf
mounts.description: It has an armored spike on its tail. Scratch its belly at your own risk.

mounts.name: Coldflame Infernal
mounts.description: The strange icy flames cause you to sweat and shiver at the same time.

mounts.name: Trained Snarler
mounts.description: Enormously cute as a puppy. Slightly less so now.

mounts.name: Swift Frostwolf
mounts.description: Amidst the cold heights of Frostfire, the frostwolves hunt anything they can catch. The fastest among them eat well.

mounts.name: Smoky Direwolf
mounts.description: Believed to reside mostly in the north. Hates weddings.

mounts.name: Dustmane Direwolf
mounts.description: Cautious by direwolf standards, the dustmane can only be coaxed to ride with something it considers special.

mounts.name: Warlord's Deathwheel
mounts.description: Often referred to as the "Goblin Lawn Mower", this growling behemoth treats enemies like they are made of grass... ready to be mown down.

mounts.name: Champion's Treadblade
mounts.description: Forged by human, gnome, and dwarf, this armored masterpiece is designed to slice a tauren into a tri-tip dinner with a flick of the handlebars.

mounts.name: Challenger's War Yeti
mounts.description: Thankfully they move fast and mostly leave the smell behind them.

mounts.name: Sunhide Gronnling
mounts.description: Loves the sun, hates everything else.

mounts.name: Llothien Prowler
mounts.description: These sleek foxes can prowl amongst newly-fallen leaves without making a sound, even at this size.

mounts.name: Garn Nighthowl
mounts.description: The garn are the most fierce predators on Draenor, and always hunt in packs.

mounts.name: Bloodfang Widow
mounts.description: Its long, serrated limbs drip with the blood of its enemies and/or mate.

mounts.name: Emerald Drake
mounts.description: "Is the emerald drake rare?  You have no idea.  If I had a silver for every time someone asked me about one, I could have retired years ago." -Mei Francis

mounts.name: Chauffeured Mechano-Hog
mounts.description: Why drive yourself around when you can hire someone to do it for you?

mounts.name: Chauffeured Mekgineer's Chopper
mounts.description: Transportation is a precise business.

mounts.name: Voidtalon of the Dark Star
mounts.description: Corrupted by the presence of the Dark Star in Draenor, the Voidtalons resisted being broken by the Shadowmoon Clan and were ultimately destroyed by Ner'zhul. Only a single egg remains, lost in the void.

mounts.name: Mystic Runesaber
mounts.description: Infused with arcane power, the Mystic Runesaber has long been hidden by chaotic nether energies. Recently they have emerged from the shadows in search of ley lines to sate their thirst for magic.

mounts.name: Felsteel Annihilator
mounts.description: Forged deep within Hellfire Citadel by a mad blacksmith, the Felsteel Annihilator combines the metalworking knowledge of the Iron Horde with the chaotic fel energies of the Burning Legion into an unholy union of steel and flame.

mounts.name: Corrupted Dreadwing
mounts.description: Bathed in the blood of demons, these corrupted Dread Ravens are significantly more aggressive, and will often kill one another if kept in confinement.

mounts.name: Vicious War Mechanostrider
mounts.description: Equipped with head-mounted Critter Destroyer 9000.

mounts.name: Vicious War Kodo
mounts.description: The spiked ball on the tail is strong enough to crush through even the most reinforced Alliance defenses.

mounts.name: Infernal Direwolf
mounts.description: A mighty wolf of Draenor, touched by the fel energies unleashed by Gul'dan in Tanaan Jungle. It has not gone completely mad... yet.

mounts.name: Primal Gladiator's Felblood Gronnling
mounts.description: One of the gronnlings of Tanaan Jungle caught in the eruption of fel energies unleashed by Gul'dan, and now beholden to an unquenchable lust for chaos.

mounts.name: Wild Gladiator's Felblood Gronnling
mounts.description: One of the gronnlings of Tanaan Jungle caught in the eruption of fel energies unleashed by Gul'dan, and now beholden to an unquenchable lust for chaos.

mounts.name: Warmongering Gladiator's Felblood Gronnling
mounts.description: One of the gronnlings of Tanaan Jungle caught in the eruption of fel energies unleashed by Gul'dan, and now beholden to an unquenchable lust for chaos.

mounts.name: Coalfist Gronnling
mounts.description: This little gronnling is well-known for smashing his way into garrison inns and making a mess of the pots and pans.

mounts.name: Illidari Felstalker
mounts.description: The Illidari have broken some lesser demons for use against their Legion masters.

mounts.name: Grove Warden
mounts.description: These magical companions are the wardens of peaceful, primordial groves within the Emerald Dream.

mounts.name: Bristling Hellboar
mounts.description: The one and only source for the rare culinary ingredient: cursed bacon.

mounts.name: Deathtusk Felboar
mounts.description: Veterans of the battle for Outland's Hellfire Peninsula are traumatized by thoughts of these beasts to this day.

mounts.name: Minion of Grumpus
mounts.description: No one quite knows when the legend of Grumpus began in Draenor, but his toys are just the worst.

mounts.name: Soaring Skyterror
mounts.description: The extra-light equipment on this chromatic rylak allows it to swoop and glide through the clouds easily, free from the bounds of the land below.

mounts.name: Grove Defiler
mounts.description: The Grove Wardens of the Emerald Dream were some of the first to fall to the corrupting influence of the Nightmare.

mounts.name: Prestigious War Steed
mounts.description: Armored to withstand collisions in battle.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Rylak
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Eclipse Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Captured from the renegade blood elves at Eclipse Point, these purple dragonhawks were often sought after by Scryers posted to the Sanctum of the Stars.

mounts.name: Spirit of Eche'ro
mounts.description: The spirit of Huln Highmountain's pet moose.

mounts.name: Felsaber
mounts.description: A special creation of Lord Illidan gifted to his most trusted demon hunters.

mounts.name: Infinite Timereaver
mounts.description: Fickle and savage, these drakes slip in and out of time until they find a worthy rider.

mounts.name: Prestigious War Wolf
mounts.description: At Warchief Hellscream's command, Horde trainers began raising wolves to thrive in the shock and ferocity of sustained combat.

mounts.name: Felblaze Infernal
mounts.description: The Illidari were able to break one of these fiery beasts for use as an unstoppable, fearless mount against the Legion.

mounts.name: Predatory Bloodgazer
mounts.description: The sheer amount of raw red berries these fierce omnivores consume gives them their distinctive eye color.

mounts.name: Brilliant Direbeak
mounts.description: The shimmering hides of these deceptively fierce and coordinated beasts are intended to confuse and disorient prey.

mounts.name: Snowfeather Hunter
mounts.description: Capable of hiding in a fog bank until prey approaches, then slicing them open with one claw-raised jump.

mounts.name: Viridian Sharptalon
mounts.description: Adept at blending into dense, magical forests, such as one may find around the Broken Isles.

mounts.name: Steelbound Devourer
mounts.description: Only the sturdiest-forged chains can restrain this beast.

mounts.name: Flarecore Infernal
mounts.description: The Legion has conquered thousands of other planets, devising fiendish alterations to their war machines when faced with extreme conditions.

mounts.name: Brinedeep Bottom-Feeder
mounts.description: These elusive fish prefer to skulk in the deepest reaches of the Great Sea, searching the darkness for food.

mounts.name: Long-Forgotten Hippogryph
mounts.description: You are the only one that remembered.

mounts.name: Mastercraft Gravewing
mounts.description: Handcrafted by the Stonewright herself, this mastefully crafted stoneborn is entrusted only to those she deems worthy.

mounts.name: Ratstallion
mounts.description: Years of chain-chugging potions in Dalaran's sewer system have allowed him to grow large, agile, and shadow resistant.

mounts.name: Prestigious Bronze Courser
mounts.description: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Royal Courser
mounts.description: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Forest Courser
mounts.description: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Ivory Courser
mounts.description: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

-Aviana

Upon her return to The Nighthold, First Arcanist Thalyssra saw to it that adventurers who helped her liberate Suramar were rewarded with prized mounts from the royal stable.

mounts.description: A mount fit for Zandalari high priests and councilers, gilded with only the finest decoration and blessed by Rezan, the great devilsaur loa.

mounts.description: It was said that this invention was modeled after the likeness of a very wealthy goblin. Although others don't really see the resemblance.

mounts.description: A gift of thanks from the Lightforged draenei, this stalwart elekk is conditioned to charge headlong into darkness without fear.

mounts.name: Nightborne Manasaber

mounts.name: Starcursed Voidstrider
mounts.description: This shadow-infused strider embodies the elves' commitment to harness the power of the Void in the name of the Alliance.

mounts.name: Admiralty Stallion
mounts.description: These sleek white stallions are the few mounts allowed to embark on Kul Tiran ships.

mounts.name: Shu-Zen, the Divine Sentinel
mounts.description: As the Golden Lotus worked tirelessly to repair the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, a single statue came to life and wordlessly defended them from the Sha that assaulted them. Believed by some to be a sign of good fortune and others to be a gift from the Light, Shu-Zen provides faithful companionship to any that would defend Azeroth from the maddening whispers of the Old Gods.

mounts.name: Green Marsh Hopper
mounts.description: Gottum collects spawns of Krag'wa from all around the Frogmarsh, but only the most bulbous are used as mounts.

mounts.name: Honeyback Harvester
mounts.description: While most Harvesters dream only of honey and flowers, this adventurous specimen looks to the wide world beyond Stormsong Valley.

mounts.name: Dapple Gray
mounts.description: A favored mount of the sea priests who call Stormsong home.

mounts.name: Smoky Charger
mounts.description: Among the oldest horse breeds in Kul Tiras, they even led many a charge in the original struggle with the drust.

mounts.name: Terrified Pack Mule
mounts.description: This poor mule was around Drustvar when the witches took over. He's seen too much.

mounts.name: Goldenmane
mounts.description: Lord Stormsong ordered his cronies to steal this horse from the Norwington Estate in Tiragarde, as he was covetous of its luscious golden mane.

mounts.name: Mighty Caravan Brutosaur
mounts.description: Brutosaurs are used by the Zandalari Empire as both weapons of war and enormous, mobile trading posts.

mounts.name: Tomb Stalker
mounts.description: These fierce beasts are entombed alongside kings so they may carry their masters through the afterlife.

mounts.name: Siltwing Albatross
mounts.description: One of the rarest of birds seen on the islands of the Great Sea, and a prized possession amongst traders, if they can capture it.

mounts.name: Kua'fon
mounts.description: Once a little hatchling, raised into a mighty pterrordax by a loving handler. He never did learn to fly.

mounts.name: Mag'har Direwolf
mounts.description: Native to Draenor, these wolves are preferred by the Mag'har for their ferocity, loyalty, and for something to snuggle on those cool winter nights.

mounts.name: Vicious War Clefthoof
mounts.description: The Mag'har bred clefthooves not only as sturdy pack animals, but also powerful instruments of war.

mounts.name: Darkforge Ram
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the defenders of Ironforge.

mounts.name: Dawnforge Ram
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the defenders of Ironforge.

mounts.name: Dark Iron Core Hound
mounts.description: You don't get dogs hotter than this.

mounts.name: Undercity Plaguebat
mounts.description: One of the last of the giant bats to escape Undercity following the siege of Lordaeron.

mounts.name: Vicious War Riverbeast
mounts.description: Riverbeasts are actually one of the most dangerous animals on Azeroth, despite their appearance.

mounts.name: The Dreadwake
mounts.description: A ship unlike any other, held aloft by a gift from an unknown kraken-faced god of the deeps.

mounts.name: Underrot Crawg
mounts.description: The eternal twilight of the Underrot has robbed this crawg of all pigmentation.

mounts.name: Teldrassil Hippogryph
mounts.description: One of the last of the great armored hippogryphs to escape the burning of Teldrassil, it carried the last few citizens it could to safety before collapsing of exhaustion.

mounts.name: Nazjatar Blood Serpent
mounts.description: Monstrous serpents riddled with corruption serve as mounts for N'zoth's high-ranking lieutenants in the Great Sea.

mounts.name: Cobalt Pterrordax
mounts.description: These pterrordax keep vigil for enemy fleets soaring above the coasts of Zandalar.

mounts.name: Captured Swampstalker
mounts.description: A swamp-dwelling subspecies of pterrordax known to feast on young bloodfeasters.

mounts.name: Voldunai Dunescraper
mounts.description: These brightly-colored fliers are rarely captured in the wild due to their naturally untrusting natures.

mounts.name: Expedition Bloodswarmer
mounts.description: Orphaned during the rout of the Blood Trolls, this bloodswarmer has been retrained by Talanji's handlers.

mounts.name: Dusky Waycrest Gryphon
mounts.description: Common to the dark forests of Drustvar, these gryphon are silent and swift. Their prowess at operating on their own or as mounts lends them to be used for ambush and shock tactics.

mounts.name: Stormsong Coastwatcher
mounts.description: Tasked with keeping watch on the seas for approaching dangers, the Stormsong Coastwatchers fly constant patrols.

mounts.name: Proudmoore Sea Scout
mounts.description: Only a few gryphons are selected to be Sea Scouts operating from flag ships in the fleet. Their long range reconnaissance is an integral part of Kul Tiran sea dominance.

mounts.name: Great Sea Ray
mounts.description: The rays of the great sea can travel for many miles in great migratory patterns.

mounts.name: Frostshard Infernal
mounts.description: These icy minions come from an unknown plane far from this one.

mounts.name: Fiery Hearthsteed
mounts.description: These flying creatures thunder unseen across the heavens. How fortunate that this one has shown itself to you!

mounts.name: Surf Jelly
mounts.description: The time between being stung and being enveloped and devoured is short enough to consider not swimming in the Great Sea.

mounts.name: Conqueror's Scythemaw
mounts.description: The battle-hardened shell of this mighty beast can turn aside even the most hefty hammer or sharpened spear.

mounts.name: Broken Highland Mustang
mounts.description: One of the Arathi horses, taken and broken by the Horde conquerors of Stromgarde.

mounts.name: Highland Mustang
mounts.description: A valiant steed on the Arathi Highlands, it knows no fear.

mounts.name: Twilight Avenger
mounts.description: Little is known about the fate of the twilight dragonflight, though they seem to exist in numbers in Grim Batol to this day.

mounts.name: Craghorn Chasm-Leaper
mounts.description: These mighty leapers have adapted to island life by learning to catch seagulls swooping through crags and fissures.

mounts.name: Qinsho's Eternal Hound
mounts.description: Qinsho wrought his eternal guardian from pure gold and imbued it with the resilience of the earth.

mounts.name: Palehide Direhorn
mounts.description: Pale-skinned direhorns are quite rare, justifying the expense.

mounts.name: Swift Albino Raptor
mounts.description: The Witherbark warrior Beastrider Kama once cut bloody swathes of terror across the Arathi Highlands astride such a monster.

mounts.name: Lil' Donkey
mounts.description: Likely stolen from Newstead in the Arathi Highlands, this stalwart little donkey was destined to be eaten by kobolds.

mounts.name: Skullripper
mounts.description: She's a clever girl.

mounts.name: Witherbark Direwing
mounts.description: Only a handful of these giant bats remain in the Arathi Highlands, carefully raised by the Witherbark forest trolls who first brought them here.

mounts.name: Pureheart Courser
mounts.description: These coursers have long been known to exist, but only befriend those that have gone to great lengths for friendship.

mounts.name: Frenzied Feltalon
mounts.description: The Legion experimented with the corruption of many different types of wildlife, such as this fiery bird species from a molten world.

mounts.name: Prestigious Bloodforged Courser
mounts.description: Forged in a fiery hatred, the offspring of a nightmare and a dream, this steed feeds on grains grown with the tears of your enemies.

mounts.name: Meat Wagon
mounts.description: A favorite unit of the Lich King, both for its power as a siege weapon, and the satisfying sound of flung meat.

mounts.name: Vicious White Warsaber
mounts.description: If you try to give it a belly scratch, you're asking for trouble.

mounts.name: Vicious Black Warsaber
mounts.description: The only thing these big cats bring home as gifts are the severed limbs of your enemies.

mounts.name: Vicious Black Bonesteed
mounts.description: These skeletal steeds know no fear, eat no grains, and can travel impossible distances.

mounts.name: Vicious White Bonesteed
mounts.description: There are few other ways to ride in to battle that feature as many spikes and bones.

mounts.name: Kul Tiran Charger
mounts.description: The Kul Tiran military prides itself on mastery of both sea, through a vast navy, and land, with armed cavalry.

mounts.name: Blackpaw
mounts.description: Blackpaw was just hibernating, minding his own business, and then suddenly there was a warfront.

mounts.name: Ashenvale Chimaera
mounts.description: Ashenvale chimaeras were used frequently by the Kaldorei to decimate structures in battles against the humans, orcs, and undead.

mounts.name: Frightened Kodo
mounts.description: Nothing frightens a kodo like seeing a bear with antlers.

mounts.name: Umber Nightsaber
mounts.description: Nightsabers are an integral part of the Kaldorei's army, serving as both mount and assault weapon in one.

mounts.name: Sandy Nightsaber
mounts.description: A rare color for a nightsaber, and rarely seen, they are prized amongst huntresses.

mounts.name: Kaldorei Nightsaber
mounts.description: The connection between a nightsaber and its hunter or huntress is nearly inseparable.

mounts.name: Blue Marsh Hopper
mounts.description: That squishing sound every time it takes a step? That's a feature.

mounts.name: Yellow Marsh Hopper
mounts.description: No one makes giant, slimy spawns like Krag'wa the Huge.

mounts.name: Saltwater Seahorse
mounts.description: These giant seahorses are naturally curious, and are often found exploring sunken ship wreckage for shiny things.

mounts.name: Stonehide Elderhorn
mounts.description: Stonehide elderhorns, one of the few types of moose to inhabit island climates, have thinner fur than most elderhorns.

mounts.name: Bloodthirsty Dreadwing
mounts.description: The forsaken prefer the use of these bloodthirsty hunters, both for their speed as a mount, and the psychological effect they have on their enemies.

mounts.name: Bloodgorged Hunter
mounts.description: If he wasn't so full, you wouldn't have caught him.

mounts.name: Island Thunderscale
mounts.description: One of the larger native dragon species on Azeroth, this subspecies subsists almost entirely on fish. And fishermen.

mounts.name: Risen Mare
mounts.description: Something terrible happened in the lost town of Havenswood.

mounts.name: Azureshell Krolusk
mounts.description: Captured from the desolate sands of Vol'dun, this mount is surprisingly docile in captivity.

mounts.name: Rubyshell Krolusk
mounts.description: Captured from the desolate sands of Vol'dun, this mount is surprisingly docile in captivity.

mounts.name: Priestess' Moonsaber
mounts.description: Once these elegant cats were only given to high-ranking priestesses of Elune, but now they ride into battle with all manner of champion, in the service of vengeance.

mounts.name: G.M.O.D.
mounts.description: Garishly sporting extreme amounts of goblin flair, Gallywix commissioned his Mech of Death to one up Mekkatorque in combat and more importantly in style.

mounts.name: Dazar'alor Windreaver
mounts.description: Soaring high above the Battle of Dazar'alor, these beasts are drawn to the most cunning of victors.

mounts.name: Glacial Tidestorm
mounts.description: Though she commands a variety of magical powers, Jaina has always been most proficient at summoning powerful elementals of water and ice.

mounts.name: Bruce
mounts.description: BRUCE!

mounts.name: Hogrus, Swine of Good Fortune
mounts.description: Hogrus was first seen by Emperor Shaohao on the third day of his meditation, and is considered by the Pandaren to be a sign of good fortune to come to those who take action.

mounts.name: Vulpine Familiar
mounts.description: A fiercely intelligent and curious species, these fox-like creatures have travelled the Great Dark Beyond and found their way to Azeroth. Drawn to Azeroth's champions, they seek adventure and companionship.

mounts.name: Sylverian Dreamer
mounts.description: An artist in the magical city of Dalaran fell asleep on her brush, and dreamed of painting a beautiful feathered dragon. Her artwork leapt from the page, and when she awoke, she found it sleeping gently beside her.

mounts.name: Wonderwing 2.0
mounts.description: Don't ask what happened to the first one -- Mechagon technology is still gnome technology!

mounts.name: Crusader's Direhorn
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the holy crusaders of Zandalar.

mounts.name: Aerial Unit R-21/X
mounts.description: King Mechagon's private aerial unit, complete with deployable blast cannon and foot warmers.

mounts.name: Rusty Mechanocrawler
mounts.description: The check engine light is always on, it's when it goes off that you should be worried.

mounts.name: Unshackled Waveray
mounts.description: The Unshackled have a natural kinship with the species of the deep seas that have seen cruelty at the hands of the naga.

mounts.name: Ankoan Waveray
mounts.description: The Ankoan have been battling the naga for years, and with a natural affinity for the sea, training the local wildlife was a natural strategy.

mounts.name: Azshari Bloatray
mounts.description: The naga raised these rays in captivity, harvesting their gas organs to craft alchemy which allowed them to breathe air more easily.

mounts.name: Royal Snapdragon
mounts.description: Captured at a young age and raised to serve naga hunters, snapdragons are loyal and fierce companions.

mounts.name: Snapback Scuttler
mounts.description: Giant crabs are native to Nazjatar and a favored food of the naga. This one must have been well-kept to grow this large.

mounts.name: X-995 Mechanocat
mounts.description: The X-995 is the ultimate in customizeable feline robo-companionship.

mounts.name: Obsidian Worldbreaker
mounts.description: "I have had many names throughout history, all of them spoken with dread: Neltharion, Xaxas, and many more. Yet you shall know me best as Deathwing, for so I am! I am the bane of life, the darkness within history, the lord of death, the master of destruction. And I tell you now, and so it is true, that this world is mine!" - Neltharion, the Earth-Warder

mounts.name: Beastlord's Irontusk
mounts.description: One of Darmac's trained beasts, its tusks can pierce even the hardest Iron Horde steel.

mounts.name: Beastlord's Warwolf
mounts.description: One of Darmac's trained beasts, it was raised in a crucible of molten fire and shows no fear.

mounts.name: Bloodflank Charger
mounts.description: Stolen from the Arathi Basin stables, this fire-hearted charger now steeds for the Horde.

mounts.name: Ironclad Frostclaw
mounts.description: Captured in the snows of Alterac Valley, this bloodthirsty hunter now roars for the Alliance.

mounts.name: Mechacycle Model W
mounts.description: The rapid technological evolution of the descendants of Mimiron began with the introduction of a new gear, leading to such wonders as the tragically under-produced Model W.

mounts.name: Junkheap Drifter
mounts.description: When you really want to be noticed... and don't mind strapping yourself to a giant, barely-held-together wheel.

mounts.name: Child of Torcali
mounts.description: This daughter of the great direhorn loa, Torcali, never lost faith that her keeper would help her grow to her full potential.

mounts.name: Mollie
mounts.description: The kind nature of alpacas makes them perfect as companions for the intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Mechagon Peacekeeper
mounts.description: Keeps the peace by turning you into pieces.

mounts.name: Scrapforged Mechaspider
mounts.description: You built this yourself, you should be proud, even though it's smoky, sparky, and loud.

mounts.name: Rustbolt Resistor
mounts.description: "R E S I S T" is carved into the seat in crude letters, along with several, more profane things.

mounts.name: Deepcoral Snapdragon
mounts.description: The snapdragon is a quiet hunter in the water, but is far less stealthy on land.

mounts.name: Snapdragon Kelpstalker
mounts.description: When a snapdragon bites you, the worry isn't about the bite itself, but the poison that will begin to eat away at the wound.

mounts.name: Silent Glider
mounts.description: Gasses naturally stored within the creature allowed it to survive within the depths, those same gasses also allow them to effortlessly float through the air.

mounts.name: Fabious
mounts.description: He emerges from the water, fins swaying lazily in the breeze, sun-kissed scales glittering. He is... Fabious.

mounts.name: Silver Tidestallion
mounts.description: This tidestallion and its silvery scales were drawn to the glint of plunder in your pocket.

mounts.name: Crimson Tidestallion
mounts.description: The blood-red coloration of these creatures is ideal for hiding in large coral formations.

mounts.name: Inkscale Deepseeker
mounts.description: Schools of tidestallions will viciously slam their muscular chests into their prey to take them down.

mounts.name: Uncorrupted Voidwing
mounts.description: This spawn of Vexiona, cleansed by Wrathion, comes from a flight with a fractured past and uncertain future.

mounts.name: Alabaster Stormtalon
mounts.description: Chiseled by the stonemasons of Stormwind, this stone gryphon symbolizes the unbending courage of the Alliance.

mounts.name: Alabaster Thunderwing
mounts.description: Chiseled by the stoneworkers of Orgrimmar, this stone wind rider is a symbol of the unwavering strength of the Horde.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Fathom Ray
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Magnetocraft
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Armored Gryphon
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Pterrordax
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Honeyback Hivemother
mounts.description: Destined to become queen of her hive, she scouts Kul Tiras and Zandalar in search of a suitable home for a new colony to flourish.

mounts.name: Black Serpent of N'Zoth
mounts.description: The black serpents of N'Zoth are the harbingers of his ultimate vision becoming reality. Only those servants or enemies that can tread this space have any chance of wrangling them.

mounts.name: Mechagon Mechanostrider
mounts.description: The best mount, logically, serves multiple purposes -- sometimes you need to get places AND reach something high up once you get there.

mounts.name: Frostwolf Snarler
mounts.description: Raised in the Alterac Mountains by the Frostwolf Clan, trained to bite dwarves.

mounts.name: Caravan Hyena
mounts.description: The canopy atop this dune-wanderer can be stored at your campsite, should you desire to feel the wind in your fur.

mounts.name: Explorer's Jungle Hopper
mounts.description: For when you're making a crash landing in the middle of an uncharted swamp because it's the only way to access that ancient temple.

mounts.name: Explorer's Dunetrekker
mounts.description: The surly dunetrekker can easily carry a set of explorers to the nearest ruins and back without the need to rest.

mounts.name: Ensorcelled Everwyrm
mounts.description: Anima is a fundamental force that infuses the Shadowlands. It flows through many creatures, but is also traded, bartered for, and fought over.

mounts.name: Squeakers, the Trickster
