mounts.description: The locals in Halfhill swear that whenever a batch of grain is missing, a farmworking instrument is misplaced, or a bushel of berries can't be found, you can hear a mischievous squeaking, and are reminded to slow down and accept what life gives you.

mounts.name: Lucky Yun
mounts.description: The Pandaren believe that merely rubbing one's hands on the shiny hide of the ox will grant prosperity, the challenge is catching it.

mounts.name: Stormpike Battle Ram
mounts.description: Raised in the Alterac Mountains by the Stormpike Clan, trained to headbutt orcs.

mounts.name: Ny'alotha Allseer
mounts.description: To find him, drown yourself in the Circle of Stars.

mounts.name: Clutch of Ha-Li
mounts.description: The brood of Ha-Li are comfortable in the blue skies of Pandaria, hunting unsuspecting prey.

mounts.name: Hopecrusher Gargon
mounts.description: Once the loyal mount of a House Briarbane lord, it turned on the lord and his retinue. Members of House Briarbane now whisper of a dark Gargon lying in wait even baiting venthyr who venture through the darker parts of the Chalice District of Revendreth.

mounts.name: Battle Gargon Vrednic
mounts.description: Prince Renathal's loyal gargon, Vrednic has been by his side for millennia. Adorned in his Sinvyr armor, Vrednic's mere presence instills terror to all those who lay eyes on him as he ushers his rider into battle.

mounts.name: Dreamlight Runestag
mounts.description: Runestags are granted to those who have pledged their service to the Winter Queen and the Court of Night.

mounts.name: Enchanted Dreamlight Runestag
mounts.description: The majestic runestags are capable of siphoning anima from the ambient light of Ardenweald with their elaborate antlers. The anima is used as nourishment and to power the runestag's speed and magic.

mounts.name: Mawsworn Soulhunter
mounts.description: Soulhunters are used to track wayward souls across the wastes that flee from their dark fates, and are one of the only creatures that feel comfortable traversing the maw.

mounts.name: Darkwarren Hardshell
mounts.description: The Darkwarren Hardshell's chitin is sturdy enough to withstand mortar shells and dragon's fire. It will also conveniently consume anything lacking anima, if needed.

mounts.name: Swift Gloomhoof
mounts.description: The ballads of Ardenweald claim that the birth of gloomrunner heralds the passing of a particularly benevolent wild god. Seeing a gloomrunner is therefore a blessing and a curse.

mounts.name: Sundancer
mounts.description: This sun-dappled courser gallops on lightbeams with carefree abandon.

mounts.name: Chittering Animite
mounts.description: These exceptionally agile fliers make excellent mounts once they've been trained not to sap every ounce of anima from their rider.

mounts.name: Horrid Dredwing
mounts.description: Harika the Horrid terrorized the denizens of the Forest Ward, and with her demise her broodlings can now take this horror to denizens farther afield.

mounts.name: Ivory Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Ivory Cloud Serpents are often mistaken for roaring thunder as they tear through the skies with blistering speed.

mounts.name: Gargantuan Grrloc
mounts.description: It's the biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Rajani Warserpent
mounts.description: Fierce companions of the followers of Ra-den, the Rajani Warserpents are a force to be reckoned with.

mounts.name: Drake of the Four Winds
mounts.description: Rocks erode, fires sputter, but wind remains powerful regardless of the passage of time. -Phaoris

mounts.name: Mail Muncher
mounts.description: Worming its way through the Postmaster's network, this serpent of N'Zoth deprived Azeroth of its primary magical correspondence.

mounts.name: Waste Marauder
mounts.description: Larger than most of its kin, this vulture has shown sick and strong beasts alike why they need to fear the skies.

mounts.name: Wastewander Skyterror
mounts.description: Doubting a Wastewander Skyterror's capabilities is a quick way to find yourself missing a limb.

mounts.name: Malevolent Drone
mounts.description: The Aqir drones feast on heroes and cowards alike to grow their ranks.

mounts.name: Shadowbarb Drone
mounts.description: Void, jelly, and a very full belly is all this drone needs.

mounts.name: Wicked Swarmer
mounts.description: When the Void reached out, the Aqir were formed in its terrible image.

mounts.name: Wriggling Parasite
mounts.description: It's so wiggly! Just looking at it move is chaotic and unnerving.

mounts.name: Elusive Quickhoof
mounts.description: The kind nature of alpacas makes them perfect as companions for the intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Awakened Mindborer
mounts.description: It may look menacing right now, but it's actually kind of cute when it's asleep.

mounts.name: Ren's Stalwart Hound
mounts.description: Houndlord Ren used his strongest quilen to carry him across Pandaria to subjugate the Vale for the Mogu empire.

mounts.name: Xinlao
mounts.description: The only thing stronger than a quilen's loyalty is its fierce devotion to making sure it covers its owner in kisses.

mounts.name: Springfur Alpaca
mounts.description: The kind nature of alpacas makes them perfect as companions for the intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Sunwarmed Furline
mounts.description: The presence of the giant felines heralds the beginning of the end for the birds of Azeroth.

mounts.name: Silky Shimmermoth
mounts.description: The moths of Ardenweald play a vital role in the ecosystem, carrying spores, anima, and pollen from one part of the forest to the other, providing nourishment and variation to the denizens living below.

mounts.name: Steamscale Incinerator
mounts.description: A mad gnomish inventor had a dream to ride a dragon, so he created this metal monstrosity. He powered it with a trapped demon, in order to create "an authentic dragon soul," and did not survive its activation.

mounts.name: Colossal Slaughterclaw
mounts.description: Only the most stalwart stable masters of Maldraxxus are able to break the will of the colossal slaughterclaws, giving all champions of the Undying Army a fearsome ally in the Shadowlands.

mounts.name: Vicious War Spider
mounts.description: When being a courageous member of the Alliance doesn't strike the right amount of fear into your opponent, add a giant spider.

mounts.name: Vicious War Spider
mounts.description: When being a bellowing member of the Horde doesn't strike the right amount of fear into your opponent, add a giant spider.

mounts.name: Shadeleaf Runestag
mounts.description: The shadeleaf runestag are bred for their ferocity as well as their beauty by the Wild Hunt. They feel no fear charging into the den of any predator.

mounts.name: Wakener's Runestag
mounts.description: Runestags enjoy lying near wildseeds. The Wakeners believe they can hear the sleepers' dreams. These runestags display a range of emotions in their vigil, signaling the dreams or nightmares of the spirits within.

mounts.name: Winterborn Runestag
mounts.description: Winterborn runestags are blessed by the Winter Queen herself. Their runes flare brilliantly when predators are nearby, warning the entire herd.

mounts.name: Enchanted Shadeleaf Runestag
mounts.description: A shadeleaf runestag is capable of goring creatures as powerful as a gorm matriarch in defense of its herd. The Wild Hunt ride these mounts into dangerous corners of the Shadowlands, when their domain must be defended from those who would threaten the wilds.

mounts.name: Enchanted Wakener's Runestag
mounts.description: Wakener runestags fiercely protect their wildseed groves. When the groves starting to fail, many runestags went berserk.

mounts.name: Enchanted Winterborn Runestag
mounts.description: Winterborn runestags are the favored mount of the Winter Queen herself, and she only bestows such a creature on her most favored subjects.

mounts.name: Shimmermist Runner
mounts.description: Mischievous spriggans and the valerunners have a natural enmity. No valerunner would deign to allow a spriggan rider because they can sense their inherent malevolence. This angers the trickster spriggans who take twisted enjoyment in playing cruel pranks on these majestic creatures.

mounts.name: Duskflutter Ardenmoth
mounts.description: These ardenmoths prefer the dark and damp forests of northwest Ardenweald, where fungal colonies are perpetually blooming.

mounts.name: Spinemaw Gladechewer
mounts.description: Spriggan riders tie bits of anima-less detritus to the end of sticks in front of their gorm mounts to steer. It's... an imperfect art.

mounts.name: Sinful Gladiator's Soul Eater
mounts.description: This mount shows a proclivity for snacking upon the souls cast out of Revendreth.

mounts.name: War-Bred Tauralus
mounts.description: The soldiers of Maldraxxus protect the Shadowlands, and require a mount that is both capable and calm when faced with overwhelming odds.

mounts.name: Plaguerot Tauralus
mounts.description: The tauralus is considered courageous, though scholars of Maldraxxus have long wondered if their lack of fear is simply due to the tiny size of their brains.

mounts.name: Bonehoof Tauralus
mounts.description: There are quite a few reasons that you do not want to stand behind a tauralus, the hooves and whip-like tails being the least of them.

mounts.name: Chosen Tauralus
mounts.description: Even an unarmored tauralus is a valuable ally in battle, its enormous horns capable of piercing even plate armor.

mounts.name: Armored War-Bred Tauralus
mounts.description: The tauralus that serve the armies of Maldraxxus have had all traits of compassion bred out of them, and are only adorned in armor when they show that no sword or spell can stop them from carrying their rider to victory.

mounts.name: Armored Plaguerot Tauralus
mounts.description: When fully armored, a tauralus can take an incredible amount of damage before falling, making it a valuable ally in battle.

mounts.name: Armored Bonehoof Tauralus
mounts.description: A favored mount of the House of the Chosen, the tauralus only gets more angry and vicious when exposed to battle.

mounts.name: Armored Chosen Tauralus
mounts.description: The tauralus has two tails, which are both absolutely necessary for whipping away buzzing pests like the bloodlouse.

mounts.name: Blisterback Bloodtusk
mounts.description: The House of the Chosen train their mounts in all manner of difficult circumstances, so that no matter the battle, they will never falter.

mounts.name: Gorespine
mounts.description: Nerissa trampled over countless bodies on the back of Gorespine as she rose to prominence as the commander of the Lichsworn forces for the House of Rituals.

mounts.name: Bonecleaver's Skullboar
mounts.description: Sabreil was known for the ruthless efficiency with which she dismembered foes, feeding their bones to her loyal skullboar.

mounts.name: Lurid Bloodtusk
mounts.description: Only bloodtusks that survive the Contest of Conquest are deemed worthy enough to become a mount of the Undying Army.

mounts.name: Silvertip Dredwing
mounts.description: Bred by the Revendreth prince, Renathal, these rare dredwing are fiercely loyal and will only let those deemed worthy by the prince himself to interact with them.

mounts.name: Rampart Screecher
mounts.description: Roosting among the ramparts of Castle Nathria, these giant dredbats act as sentinels and are trained to take down threats approaching the castle from the air.

mounts.name: Harvester's Dredwing
mounts.description: The dredwings of the Harvesters fear no mawsworn, and will gleefully sink their teeth into anything that threatens Sinfall.

mounts.name: Endmire Flyer
mounts.description: Attracted through portals through which little is known these flying devourers have found a home in the Endmire of Revendreth feeding on the latent anima.

mounts.name: Inquisition Gargon
mounts.description: The gargon of the Inquisitors are some of the most vicious ever carved. The Avowed seek to recapture these beasts and return them to the righteous duty of assisting in the purifying of souls rather than the perversions performed at the hands of the Inquisitors.

mounts.name: Sinfall Gargon
mounts.description: The gargon are the loyal mounts and companions of the Venthyr and Renathal has found many abandoned at Sinfall, awaiting reawakening and assignment to worthy members of the covenant.

mounts.name: Crypt Gargon
mounts.description: Loyal hounds of the Curator, these gargon patrol the crypts and catacombs deterring both trespassing and escape.

mounts.name: Desire's Battle Gargon
mounts.description: The Countess maintains a small stable of elegantly adorned gargon mounts for her sole use. Many a rival has been taken in by the finery to their peril as she personally oversees their deadly training.

mounts.name: Gravestone Battle Gargon
mounts.description: Representative of a new loyal batch of gargon, these battle ready beasts will take Renathal's most loyal compatriots into the final battles against the Jailer.

mounts.name: Battle Gargon Silessa
mounts.description: Silessa fought valiantly alongside her master in the great incursion by the Light, following the battle her master set her to guard over a vault room of great value.

mounts.name: Loyal Gorger
mounts.description: Crawling forth from the cracks between the realms, the devourers have a voracious appetite for anima. Little is known of their origins, but all denizens of the Shadowlands see their recent boldness as a sign of the end times.

mounts.name: Pale Acidmaw
mounts.description: The acid present in the ichor of this creature sapped away the color from its shell, leaving it a striking shade of snowy white.

mounts.name: Wild Glimmerfur Prowler
mounts.description: This prowler's brilliant green coat distinguishes it from the blues and purples of Ardenweald, making it much easier for others of its kind to see through the midnight woods.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Loyalty
mounts.description: Some within the Ascended keep a phalynx as a pet. While they may not be as furry as a larion, they are much less likely to eat your other pets.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Humility
mounts.description: The phalynx does not fetch, though it is not known why this is.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Courage
mounts.description: A phalynx is considered both a worthy companion and a lithe opponent to test one's reflexes against.

mounts.name: Wildseed Cradle
mounts.description: The most precious cargo in all Ardenweald, the wildseeds, are cradled by this lovingly-crafted cart. It is imbued with anima to allow it to hover over the ground.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Purity
mounts.description: Little is known about the origination of phalynx technology, the machinations of which are taught more akin to religion than engineering.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Purity
mounts.description: The armored phalynx is a favorite companion of the mightiest warriors of the Ascended as it is both fearless and vicious in battle.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Courage
mounts.description: Many bars of gildenite are required to forge one of these sparkling mounts, but the sight of them alone is worth the gathering time.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Loyalty
mounts.description: A marvel of steward engineering, the armored phalynx is a rare and awe-inspiring sight.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Humility
mounts.description: When an armored phalynx is forged, stewards clap their hammers together in reverence of the skill required in its creation.

mounts.name: Silverwind Larion
mounts.description: This gift of the silvery winds is only bestowed upon those that search high and low for the wisdom of Bastion.

mounts.name: Restoration Deathwalker
mounts.description: With the death of the Jailer and the ascension of a new Arbiter, the Shadowlands is returning to its great Purpose. Some deathwalkers recognize the role that mortal heroes have played, and are willing to serve as mounts.

mounts.name: Marrowfang
mounts.description: Marrowfang, Bonefang's progeny, was respected by Amarth the Harvester for her insatiable appetite, even if it disrupted any experiments that the sadistic commander wanted to run.

mounts.name: Callow Flayedwing
mounts.description: Flayedwings are a necessary force in the cycle of life for the Shadowlands, acting as both prey and predator for the harsh environment of Maldraxxus.

mounts.name: Gruesome Flayedwing
mounts.description: The flayedwings of Maldraxxus are prized for their ability to soar effortlessly through the skies of the Shadowlands, allowing their rider a surprise opportunity to strike at their foes or support their allies.

mounts.name: Bonesewn Fleshroc
mounts.description: Only expert flesh-stitchers who have demonstrated mastery over the magics of Maldraxxus are powerful enough to construct a deathroc of this size.

mounts.name: Hulking Deathroc
mounts.description: Deathrocs are stitched monstrosities from the discarded viscera, bone, and organs that were not required to construct soldiers for the House of Constructs.

mounts.name: Predatory Plagueroc
mounts.description: Gieger's everlasting hunger is legendary amongst the House of Constructs, and no beast is too large or bony to fit inside its massive stomach.

mounts.name: Dauntless Duskrunner
mounts.description: The Path of Ascension is a challenging trial, and those that display all of the facets the Kyrian hold dear will be duly rewarded.

mounts.name: Sinrunner Blanchy
mounts.description: In life, Blanchy appeared to be an affectionate, well-behaved horse of excellent disposition and appetite. What evils must she have committed in secret to have earned her place among the condemned souls of Revendreth?

mounts.name: Arboreal Gulper
mounts.description: The wood and foliage growing atop this toad is a natural part of its body, helping it siphon anima from the air to nourish itself.

mounts.name: Mawsworn Charger
mounts.description: The fate of all horse mounts.

mounts.name: Hand of Hrestimorak
mounts.description: The treachery of Hrestimorak was infamous, betraying his people to claim power. Facing damnation in the Maw, he tried to subvert the Jailer... a foolish act that would earn him an eternity of torment.

mounts.name: Sintouched Deathwalker
mounts.description: Forged from the sins of countless diabolical dungeon denizens. Only those with the skills to overcome them may hold its reins.

mounts.name: Umbral Scythehorn
mounts.description: Umbral gorm are the most docile of all gorm, but they also grow the largest horns and mandibles. They are probably so docile because other creatures avoid riling them.

mounts.name: Court Sinrunner
mounts.description: Sinrunners were once the steeds of dark souls, carried in the wake of either their sins or their masters' sins to Revendreth. While some chose to run free, many continue to serve darkness in death as they did in life.

mounts.name: Warstitched Darkhound
mounts.description: These warhounds are crafted by the House of Constructs to carry any rider into the thick of battle, rending and tearing enemy mounts all the while.

mounts.name: Highwind Darkmane
mounts.description: The Forsworn and their mounts take on a darker aspect upon renouncing the path laid forth by the Archon. While tame enough to ride, the Highwind Darkmane has a fiercely independent streak.

mounts.name: Snowstorm
mounts.description: He comes from the ice and snow, under the Azeroth sun where adventurers go.

mounts.name: Gilded Prowler
mounts.description: The mighty larion is an apex predator of Bastion, but that does not stop it from enjoying a nice nap in the sunny fields.

mounts.name: Ascended Skymane
mounts.description: Only those that have proven themselves against the combined might of the Ascended will be able to ride this mount.

mounts.name: Amber Ardenmoth
mounts.description: The brilliant orange hue of the amber ardenmoth signals to predators that it is dangerous to eat. Consuming one of these creatures will put a predator into a dreamless sleep for years.

mounts.name: Vibrant Flutterwing
mounts.description: These minty green moths are very friendly. They particularly enjoy having their head fuzz vigorously brushed. They also enjoy music and poetry.

mounts.name: Desertwing Hunter
mounts.description: In service of the great Purpose, desertwing hunters were designed to fill distant skies of forgotten realms of the Shadowlands.

mounts.name: Pale Regal Cervid
mounts.description: Looking at these majestic creatures, it's not difficult to see how the idea of cervids developed into the stags found on Azeroth and other mortal worlds.

mounts.name: Vespoid Flutterer
mounts.description: A flutterer is an overgrown vespoid worker created to carry a rider. Rather than looking to a queen for leadership, it looks to its rider to guide it in all things.

mounts.name: Deepstar Aurelid
mounts.description: As one of the last remaining polyps of an elusive creature, this aurelid is at home in the water as much as the air.

mounts.name: Battle-Hardened Aquilon
mounts.description: The aquilon can be a valuable ally in combat, with capabilities exceeding those of the phalynx.

mounts.name: Battle-Bound Warhound
mounts.description: Warhounds find comfort in conflict, and the Contest of Conquest is the perfect place to find these beasts honing their abilities.

mounts.name: Bulbous Necroray
mounts.description: The necrorays of Maldraxxus prefer to congregate around the enormous decaying mushrooms of the region.

mounts.name: Infested Necroray
mounts.description: Necrorays lay their eggs in small clusters within the frills and hollows of decaying fungal blooms.

mounts.name: Pestilent Necroray
mounts.description: When a necroray hatches, spores fly everywhere, making a huge mess.

mounts.name: Bound Shadehound
mounts.description: Created by deciphering and performing powerful runic magic, this Shadehound is bound to its creator.

mounts.name: Corridor Creeper
mounts.description: The loyal hounds of the Jailer creep along the corridors in search of the scent of souls.

mounts.name: Voracious Gorger
mounts.description: The devourers are presumed to have their origins in the In-Between, a space between the lands of the Shadowlands that few have explored.

mounts.name: Viridian Phase-Hunter
mounts.description: Hailing from a species already adept at natural camouflage, the otherworldly energies that transformed Draenor into Outland gave these creatures the ability to shift through space.

mounts.name: Slime Serpent
mounts.description: This mysterious creature lurks beneath the slime pools of Plaguefall. No one knows where it came from.

mounts.name: Tazavesh Gearglider
mounts.description: Brokers of all types use these gliders to travel around Tazavesh and similar nearby outposts, and carry their goods as well.

mounts.name: Serenade
mounts.description: These beautiful helicids emerge only at night. When they are pleased, their shells hum with a joyful melody.

mounts.name: Lord of the Corpseflies
mounts.description: To be the Lord of the Corpseflies, you've got to lay a LOT of eggs.

mounts.name: Soaring Razorwing
mounts.description: The hide of the razorwing is light, allowing it to fly, but also quite tough, allowing them to survive passage into the Maw.

mounts.name: Vicious War Croaker
mounts.description: These creatures are so enthusiastic when charging into battle that they will croak out something that sounds very much like "FOR THE HORDE!"

mounts.name: Vicious War Croaker
mounts.description: These creatures are so enthusiastic when charging into battle that they will croak out something that sounds very much like "FOR THE ALLIANCE!"

mounts.name: Tamed Mauler
mounts.description: When it comes to taming devourers, all it takes is a little anima and a lot of patience. And a lot of healing potions.

mounts.name: Beryl Shardhide
mounts.description: These shardhides find it easy to hide in the underbrush, and it is rare to find one that is tamed.

mounts.name: Sapphire Skyblazer
mounts.description: These brilliant blue birds burn brighter (and hotter) than their orange cousins, though the origin of both remains a mystery.

mounts.name: Wandering Ancient
mounts.description: A staunch defender of the forests of Azeroth, the ancients are also known for their glorious canopies of leaves, which change color with the seasons.

mounts.name: Vicious War Gorm
mounts.description: The gorm love eating the corpses of your enemies, so this seemed like a natural fit.

mounts.name: Vicious War Gorm
mounts.description: The gorm love eating the corpses of your enemies, so this seemed like a natural fit.

mounts.name: Vicious Warstalker
mounts.description: Trample the Horde to dust while riding a majestic protoform wolf! For the Alliance!

mounts.name: Vicious Warstalker
mounts.description: Trample the Alliance to dust while riding a majestic protoform wolf! For the Horde!

mounts.name: Noble Bruffalon
mounts.description: It is a great honor to be trusted with one of the Maruuk's loyal hunting companions. This Bruffalon is reliable and steadfast through any hardship.

mounts.name: Amber Skitterfly
mounts.description: A gift from Granpap Whiskers to the Trading Post, amber skitterflies are remarkably docile.

mounts.name: Magmashell
mounts.description: Who's a good little new-forged snail made entirely of elemental lava? You are! Yes, you!

mounts.name: Liquid Hot Magma Slug
mounts.description: Also referred to as lava slugs once they breach Azeroth's crust.

mounts.name: Vengeance
mounts.description: Sylvanas lost a part of herself the day Arthas took her life, and the darkness within her grew to fill the void.

mounts.name: Bestowed Thunderspine Packleader
mounts.description: A gift from Merithra, who blessed these thunderspines to ensure that no matter where the Maruuk clans roam, they will always be under the green dragonflight's protection.

mounts.name: Hand of Bahmethra
mounts.description: The most wicked and cruel of her kin, Bahmethra endured the full measure of the Banished One's punishments before her fall.

mounts.name: Wild Hunt Legsplitter
mounts.description: Integrated into the depleted forces of the Wild Hunt, the fawn riders quickly found that the gorm's powerful mandibles were perfect for cutting down close enemy ranks.

mounts.name: Undying Darkhound
mounts.description: The Undying Darkhound's parts have graced many battlefields, yet this latest battle may have been the first time they all fought together.

mounts.name: Skyskin Hornstrider
mounts.description: The instability of primalist storms in potential timelines sometimes causes creatures to absorb the energies from the very storms. These creatures tend to be docile towards those who are able to face the fury of these chronomatic anomalies.

mounts.name: Unchained Gladiator's Soul Eater
mounts.description: This soul eater's gaze unnerves you. Best not meet its eyes for too long.

mounts.name: Cartel Master's Gearglider
mounts.description: Only the richest cartel leaders are able to afford the metals required to craft the Cartel Master's Gearglider.

mounts.name: Xy Trustee's Gearglider
mounts.description: Cartel Xy trades in many currencies; none are as valuable to its inner circle as loyalty.

mounts.name: Vandal's Gearglider
mounts.description: A rarer, customized glider most commonly used for clandestine gatherings. Its silence makes it near impossible to detect, making it a favored tool for those who work in the shadows.

mounts.name: Ardenweald Wilderling
mounts.description: As anima flows to the distant wealds of Ardenweald once more, the wilderlings awaken and cautiously emerge from their canopy burrows.

mounts.name: Autumnal Wilderling
mounts.description: The wilderlings are benevolent, magical creatures of Ardenweald, and are drawn to souls that are strong and pure.

mounts.name: Winter Wilderling
mounts.description: Wilderlings serve as support units in battle, preserving their allies and rendering enemy magics useless.

mounts.name: Summer Wilderling
mounts.description: Stubborn and rebellious, this wilderling is loyal to very few. But those few are bonded for life.

mounts.name: Obsidian Gravewing
mounts.description: In the darkened skies of Revendreth, you cannot see these creatures coming until it is too late.

mounts.name: Sinfall Gravewing
mounts.description: With anima once again flowing in Sinfall, the Stonewright has been able to infuse these Stoneborn, making them valuable allies in the battles to come.

mounts.name: Pale Gravewing
mounts.description: Gravewings know no fear and are nearly indestructible -- perfect for an assault on the Maw.

mounts.name: Elysian Aquilon
mounts.description: With anima once again flowing to the Eternal Forge in Bastion, the plans for the aquilon centurion could be crafted once more.

mounts.name: Forsworn Aquilon
mounts.description: Originally produced by the Forsworn with stolen blueprints, these powerful centurion are now earning a reputation across the Shadowlands.

mounts.name: Ascendant's Aquilon
mounts.description: The aquilon can rapidly transport aspirants, stewards, and even ascended to a location. Hey, sometimes your wings get tired.

mounts.name: Maldraxxian Corpsefly
mounts.description: Corpseflies were once found throughout Maldraxxus, but many died out in the absence of anima. With anima flowing once again, they swarm.

mounts.name: Regal Corpsefly
mounts.description: Only the forces of Maldraxxus would call a corpsefly "regal."

mounts.name: Battlefield Swarmer
mounts.description: Corpseflies are strongly attracted to the smell of dead bodies and will swarm an active battlefield as soon as the first corpse falls.

mounts.name: Sanctum Gloomcharger
mounts.description: Only the Jailer's most powerful lieutenants are gifted these steeds to stalk the halls of the Tower.

mounts.name: Soulbound Gloomcharger
mounts.description: Ve'nari has many methods of sneaking around the Maw and disrupting the Jailer's plans, including binding his own minions.

mounts.name: Fallen Charger
mounts.description: The charger's screams echo across the Maw as it continues a never-ending ride across the land, forever looking for escape from the endless torments it has been forced to endure.

mounts.name: Hand of Nilganihmaht
mounts.description: Of all the giants who dared defy the Jailer, Nilganihmaht was the most arrogant. For this transgression, the giant's severed hand was hidden within a veil of torments, and the rings that could summon it back were scattered across the Maw.

mounts.name: Hand of Salaranga
mounts.description: Salaranga was the most cunning of her kin and hid amongst the Beastwarrens. She struck at the Banished One with a horde of bestial allies. It did not matter.

mounts.name: Amber Shardhide
mounts.description: The bright colors of Korthian wildlife indicate that they have either few predators, or are tough enough to fight back.

mounts.name: Crimson Shardhide
mounts.description: When Korthia was pulled into The Maw, only a few hardy species survived.

mounts.name: Darkmaul
mounts.description: An older shardhide, Darkmaul was relatively tame and friendly around Korthians. He was thought lost to the calamity.

mounts.name: Fierce Razorwing
mounts.description: Razorwings generally stay away from other Korthian species, but with time and patience, they can be tamed as well.

mounts.name: Garnet Razorwing
mounts.description: Korthia was once known for its bright red flowers. Several species were known for consuming or rolling in them, and taking on bright red coloration as a result.

mounts.name: Dusklight Razorwing
mounts.description: Razorwings can be seen throughout Korthia, making their nests on high hills and in trees.

mounts.name: Maelie, the Wanderer
mounts.description: A curious and inquisitive doe, she doesn't mean to worry her master, she just gets distracted easily. Especially with all of the new things to see on Korthia.

mounts.name: Sarge's Tale
mounts.description: Hold on a sec, Sarge isn't that large, someone must have spun a tall tale in the Hearthstone Tavern...

mounts.name: Rampaging Mauler
mounts.description: One would think controlling a rampaging mount would be difficult, but if you can learn to control the direction of the rampage it can be quite useful.

mounts.name: Bound Blizzard
mounts.description: A flurrious, fridgid friend, frost-flecked for frozen fun.

mounts.name: Soultwisted Deathwalker
mounts.description: A howling vortex of tormented souls, ridden only by those who wish to demonstrate their impressive tolerance for pain and suffering.

mounts.name: Val'sharah Hippogryph
mounts.description: These majestic hippogryphs are as close to a being of the Emerald Dream as any resident of Azeroth can be, and do not bond with a rider easily.

mounts.name: Heartlight Vombata
mounts.description: The Enlightened revere all creations of the First Ones, yet for many, the vombata of Zereth Mortis are the most beloved. These creatures are equal parts trusted beast of burden and beloved companion.

mounts.name: Curious Crystalsniffer
mounts.description: Most vombata enjoy tunneling through the ground, but these sniffers seem to have an unerring ability to locate crystals buried deep underground and will congregate around large deposits.

mounts.name: Darkened Vombata
mounts.description: The schematic to synthesize these darkened vombata seem to have appeared as a reaction to the Mawsworn invasion. The resulting vombata look different--darker, much like the invaders--but behave normally.

mounts.name: Adorned Vombata
mounts.description: Red-colored vombata are considered lucky by the Enlightened. It was a red vombata that was present when they first arrived in Zereth Mortis.

mounts.name: Deathrunner
mounts.description: These wild cervids are only truly at peace when running through--or between--the lands of Death.

mounts.name: Sundered Zerethsteed
mounts.description: Whatever the purpose of these cervids once was, it is long forgotten. Though they are not Dominated, they have been corrupted by the unintended presence of Mawsworn in the sacred realm of Zereth Mortis.

mounts.name: Anointed Protostag
mounts.description: Only those most esteemed by the Enlightened are trusted with the reins of this rare cervid.

mounts.name: Wen Lo, the River's Edge
mounts.description: The rivers of Pandaria, like Wen Lo, are unpredictable in nature. They may remain calm, bringing water to the crops, or flood, bringing ruin. Wen Lo reminds us that we must adapt to the challenges of life.

mounts.name: Soaring Spelltome
mounts.description: In the forgotten depths of the Dalaran library, this oversized tome was found flapping madly around the room. Open the pages of this arcane-infused book and hitch a ride to magical adventure.

mounts.name: Forged Spiteflyer
mounts.description: There's nothing that can make you feel as alive quite like riding through the realm of Death while atop a being that hates you.

mounts.name: Buzz
mounts.description: Buzz buzz buzz, buzz buzz! Buzz buzz buzz buzz buzz. Buzz buzz buzz, buzz buzz buzz.

mounts.name: Bronzewing Vespoid
mounts.description: Bronzewing vespoids are the result of attempting to synthesize a vespoid queen with no other members of a new hive. While no mortal has yet discovered how to synthesize a hive, the bronzewings are reliable mounts just as they are.

mounts.name: Mawdapted Raptora
mounts.description: Since the Jailer's incursion, new raptora have been synthesized by Zereth Mortis that are capable of resisting the corrupting influence of the Maw.

mounts.name: Raptora Swooper
mounts.description: The raptora swooper is one of the most vicious iterations of its kind, perfectly suited for its ecological niche. Needing no further adjustments, the ones synthesized today are identical to those created in the past.

mounts.name: Bronze Helicid
mounts.description: Some helicids of Zereth Mortis have strangely metallic shells. The ones who do are generally a bronze color, indistinct from the metal any novice miner could work, save that this creature's construction far surpasses the skill of any novice.

mounts.name: Unsuccessful Prototype Fleetpod
mounts.description: This creature was not designed by the First Ones, but instead by an unknown being attempting to create a very fast runner. Needless to say the attempt failed, because this mount is very slow.

mounts.name: Scarlet Helicid
mounts.description: This helicid's unusual reddish tint is clearly intentional in its design, but the only other difference between these and other helicids is the unusual lack of any ooze.

mounts.name: Genesis Crawler
mounts.description: The Enlightened who have observed tarachnids believe that this variety may be some of the first beings to ever walk the land of Zereth Mortis.

mounts.name: Tarachnid Creeper
mounts.description: These tarachnids make their home in the darkest corners of Zereth Mortis, coming out only to hunt (or, sometimes, carry a rider around).

mounts.name: Ineffable Skitterer
mounts.description: These tarachnids move with a purpose unknown to others, answering only to a higher calling. Whatever that may be, it appears to include routine assistance to mortals who need a ride. For now.

mounts.name: Wastewarped Deathwalker
mounts.description: Raw swirling energy bound together into a cohesive form, it will only bend to the will of those strong enough to bind it.

mounts.name: Divine Kiss of Ohn'ahra
mounts.description: ...as though welcomed by the wind itself.

mounts.name: Iskaara Trader's Ottuk
mounts.description: There are no guarantees when you purchase an ottuk from Tattukiaka. At least they're cute.

mounts.name: Goldplate Bufonid
mounts.description: This armored bufonid is always ready to leap into battle... as long as that battle is really, really close. In a pinch, it can leap multiple times and eventually reach the battle.

mounts.name: Shimmering Aurelid
mounts.description: Though it was once created to defend the Sepulcher of the First Ones, with its primary function now completed, it now obediently follows your command.

mounts.name: Depthstalker
mounts.description: Poached from Zereth Mortis, a few of these jellyfish were lost when the poachers' ship sank. They found a new home in the Great Sea's depths.

mounts.name: Cryptic Aurelid
mounts.description: The Cyphers of the First Ones are beyond any mortal understanding. A curious effect of the language is that, for reasons unknown, some aurelids are drawn to mortals who aspire to unlock its mystery.

mounts.name: Carcinized Zerethsteed
mounts.description: The few of these mysterious creatures that remain appear to be impossibly old, almost timeless. Perhaps they were created by the First Ones, because no schematic to synthesize these has yet been discovered.

mounts.name: Liberated Slyvern
mounts.description: It's difficult to tell because it's far too angry, but this slyvern is actually glad it's not owned by gnolls anymore.

mounts.name: Tangled Dreamweaver
mounts.description: The last of the sleepers are finally awakening, bringing the dreams of the dragons back to the lands.

mounts.name: Highland Drake
mounts.description: The drakes of Azure Span follow a strict personal code of honor as they explore the isles anew.

mounts.name: Colossal Soulshredder Mawrat
mounts.description: The incredible prowess you have demonstrated within the Jailer's Tower has instilled sufficient respect into this fearsome creature, enabling its use as a mount.

mounts.name: Colossal Umbrahide Mawrat
mounts.description: This disturbingly large Mawrat is an anomaly amongst its species. These Colossal Mawrats lurk only in the most distant and darkest reaches of Torghast.

mounts.name: Colossal Ebonclaw Mawrat
mounts.description: This vicious and cunning creature has grown to its astonishing size by not only feasting upon the weakened souls in the Jailer's Tower, but also vulnerable Mawsworn.

mounts.name: Lightforged Ruinstrider
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the Lightforged Draenei.

mounts.name: Patient Bufonid
mounts.description: Some bufonids will sit perfectly still for hours or days at a time if left to their own devices. Fortunately, they're also quite agreeable if a rider would like to move more often than that.

mounts.name: Prototype Leaper
mounts.description: An ancient schematic allows for the instantiation of this early, but functional, bufonid design.

mounts.name: Russet Bufonid
mounts.description: Russet is a rare color among bufonids that is normally only seen on specimens that are tainted by other cosmic forces, or synthesized from a perplexing schematic that invokes that color.

mounts.name: Cosmic Gladiator's Soul Eater
mounts.description: This soul eater's gaze unnerves you. Best not meet its eyes for too long.

mounts.name: Magenta Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: More affectionate than their cousins, Magenta Cloud Serpents are known to form close bonds with their riders.

mounts.name: Crusty Crawler
mounts.description: This rare giant crab has taken a break from its nautical nonsense deep under the sea to explore the surface.

mounts.name: Quawks
mounts.description: Squawks's older (and somehow louder) brother appears to tolerate your presence. For now. You should probably track down some crackers while you still can.

mounts.name: Jigglesworth Sr.
mounts.description: It's unclear how the saddle stays atop this formerly feline friend, but somehow the House of Plagues made it work. Science.

mounts.name: Ash'adar, Harbinger of Dawn
mounts.description: Kaldorei legends whisper of a relentless hunter prowling amongst the deepest shadows of Kalimdor, never sleeping. By the light of the sun or the moon, Ash'adar now hunts with you.

mounts.name: Coral-Stalker Waveray
mounts.description: This species of ray seems to have evolved to stalk its prey amidst the brightly colored corals of the seas.

mounts.name: Heartbond Lupine
mounts.description: From the moment of its creation, this packless lupine has held nothing more than deepest affection and loyalty towards you.

mounts.name: Nether-Gorged Greatwyrm
mounts.description: Few mana wyrms find sufficiently stable sources of arcane power to reach such a size. A greatwyrm's appetite for mana is unmatched.

mounts.name: Savage Green Battle Turtle
mounts.description: Turtle too slow to chase down your foes? Just add cannons. Nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Armored Siege Kodo
mounts.description: Only the strongest and most fearless of kodos can be trained to become living siege weapons. Even the highest walls won't keep them out for long.

mounts.name: Colossal Plaguespew Mawrat
mounts.description: These rodents became Iska's infamous sentries, scouting and carrying her plague across the Maw. Their presence is only followed by ruin.

mounts.name: Colossal Wraithbound Mawrat
mounts.description: Infused by the energies of tormented souls, these creatures have adopted ghostlike abilities that make them quite elusive.

mounts.name: Armored Golden Pterrordax
mounts.description: Painted and adorned with gold, these Pterrordax patrol the skies over the tomb of Atal'Dazar.

mounts.name: Zereth Overseer
mounts.description: Enigmatic and aloof, this construct of the First Ones flies on a graceful stream of perfect geometric understanding.

mounts.name: Winding Slitherdrake
mounts.description: These drakes feel at home in the depths of the earth and the far reaches of the sky.

mounts.name: Renewed Proto-Drake
mounts.description: As the isles awaken, these proto-drakes answer the call to soar the skies alongside mortals.

mounts.name: Windborne Velocidrake
mounts.description: The long talons of the velocidrake give it an edge on the plains.

mounts.name: Cliffside Wylderdrake
mounts.description: Often roosting along the steep cliff faces of Thaldraszus, they're swift to the skies in times of danger.

mounts.name: Jade, Bright Foreseer
mounts.description: The presence of this majestic Pandaren rabbit spirit brings joy and happiness and is heralded as a wonderful omen. Legend says that in its eyes, you can glimpse the greatest happiness of your life, even if it is yet to come.

mounts.name: Cerulean Marsh Hopper
mounts.description: Gottum's expansion into export markets was inevitable with news of the Trading Post reaching even into the depths of the Frogmarsh.

mounts.name: Amalgam of Rage
mounts.description: The fearsome beast ridden by Astaroth himself is now yours to command.

mounts.name: Grimhowl
mounts.description: Otherwise known as The Flame Woof, the Fetcher of the Igneous, Molten Core's Best Friend, Forgehound Maximus, the Best Fiery Boy, and "oh no is that an AXE on his face!?"

mounts.name: Eternal Gladiator's Soul Eater
mounts.description: This soul eater's gaze unnerves you. Best not meet its eyes for too long.

mounts.name: Elusive Emerald Hawkstrider
mounts.description: Unseen for many years, this brightly hued hawkstrider emerged from hiding to help defend the Ghostlands from the Scourge. Its prowess shines as brilliantly as its feathers.

mounts.name: Tuskarr Shoreglider
mounts.description: The Tuskarr learned long ago that some of the bones of the sea creatures they hunted were light and buoyant, making for effective glider materials.

mounts.name: Subterranean Magmammoth
mounts.description: Awakened from a long slumber, this beast has yet to see the light of day.

mounts.name: Dragon Isles Drake Model Test
mounts.description: NYI

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Drake
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Loyal Magmammoth
mounts.description: Liberated from the Qalashi and harnessed by your ingenuity (and your harness), this magmammoth is ready to lava stomp wherever you want to go.

mounts.name: Stormtouched Bruffalon
mounts.description: Even from within her prison, Raszageth's primal scorn brought the mightiest beasts to heel.

mounts.name: Tamed Skitterfly
mounts.description: It didn't take long for Granpap Whiskers to tame the skitterflies around the Dragonscale Basecamp and set them to helping move Expedition personnel and cargo.

mounts.name: Azure Skitterfly
mounts.description: Once Granpap Whiskers finally taught them how to take riders, the azure skitterflies proved to bond closely and loyally to their riders.

mounts.name: Verdant Skitterfly
mounts.description: Verdant skitterflies are the perfect mount for the scouts of the Dragonscale Expedition scouts, as they are fast and blend into the foliage of the Dragon Isles.

mounts.name: Bestowed Sandskimmer
mounts.description: A gift from Granpap Whiskers, these capricious skitterflies help the Timewalkers clean up present (and future) sand-related temporal calamities.

mounts.name: Ancient Salamanther
mounts.description: Due to their preference for dark caves and murky waters, sightings of this unique breed of salamanther are so rare that many researchers thought they had gone extinct.

mounts.name: Coralscale Salamanther
mounts.description: As Raszageth's storms abated, this aquatic breed of salamanther was among the many wonders to settle among the shores in their wake.

mounts.name: Stormhide Salamanther
mounts.description: Sometimes when storm energies infuse a creature, it simply... becomes larger and more placid. Few salamanthers are willing to be ridden, but these children of the storm are a notable exception.

mounts.name: Seething Slug
mounts.description: Drawn forth from its abyss by the rage of the Zaqali.

mounts.name: Shellack
mounts.description: Fed by victory and hardened by glory, this snail is nothing less than a tribute to mastery.

mounts.name: Gooey Snailemental
mounts.description: Formed from the leftover elemental energies of the Primal Storms, this magical mollusk is faster than it appears.

mounts.name: Scrappy Worldsnail
mounts.description: For the Worldbreakers, a portable footstool. For you, a hardy mount.

mounts.name: Bestowed Trawling Mammoth
mounts.description: A gift from Scout Tomul, so that the feasts of Iskaara will always have enough fish to feed those in need.

mounts.name: Mossy Mammoth
mounts.description: Preserved for thousands of years in stone, bronze magic has nearly aged this mammoth back into a fossil.

mounts.name: Plainswalker Bearer
mounts.description: The mammoths of the Ohn'ahran Plains are unaccustomed to carrying people, as their centaur neighbors do not typically ride mounts. They can learn to bear riders, however. Some even do so enthusiastically.

mounts.name: Explorer's Stonehide Packbeast
mounts.description: A true explorer never stays in one place for long. Having a reliable packbeast with a strong back and sturdy legs is essential for travel.

mounts.name: Lizi, Thunderspine Tramper
mounts.description: Nothing will stop Lizi from her mission to eat all the world's fruit.

mounts.name: Raging Magmammoth
mounts.description: Most lava flows. This lava charges.

mounts.name: Renewed Magmammoth
mounts.description: Reforged after destruction at the hands of the Druids of the Flame, this magmammoth is ready to stomp any foes in its path.

mounts.name: Bestowed Ottuk Vanguard
mounts.description: A gift from Brena, the Iskaara sent their most loyal (and adorable) companions to watch over Kalecgos and his reuinited family in Valdrakken

mounts.name: Brown War Ottuk
mounts.description: The tuskarr of Iskaara are loathe to war against anyone, but many tuskarr and their allies have nonetheless taken up the spear with a war ottuk beside them.

mounts.name: Otterworldly Ottuk Carrier
mounts.description: Some ottuks get into the spirit of carrying people around more than others.

mounts.name: Yellow War Ottuk
mounts.description: The yellow ottuks of the Azure Span are sleek, sneaky, and smart. Those trained for war are the finest tuskarr cavalry mounts, equally capable on the ground and in the waters.

mounts.name: Otto
mounts.description: Relax. The future will unfold as it was meant to, one way or an otter.

mounts.name: Brown Scouting Ottuk
mounts.description: Wily and playful in their natural habitat, ottuks possess keen eyes that can scout far afield as ably as they watch for predators.

mounts.name: Ivory Trader's Ottuk
mounts.description: No adult knows why some ottuks are white, but any tuskarr child can tell you: it's because they eat too much snow.

mounts.name: Yellow Scouting Ottuk
mounts.description: The yellow scouting ottuk love to hide and they blend in well to their surroundings. When not 'playing' hide and seek with their riders, they are perfect companions when scouting enemy encampments.

mounts.name: Crimson Gladiator's Drake
mounts.description: Forged in the fires of conquest, and armored to the teeth.

mounts.name: Telix the Stormhorn
mounts.description: Once a simple beetle of the Forbidden Reach, Telix became infused with storm magic when Raszageth was unleashed. With its newly heightened senses, Telix roams the Dragon Isles alongside the Dragonscale Expedition--and you!

mounts.name: Guardian Vorquin
mounts.description: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Swift Armored Vorquin
mounts.description: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Armored Vorquin Leystrider
mounts.description: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Majestic Armored Vorquin
mounts.description: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Bestowed Ohuna Spotter
mounts.description: A gift from the Ohn'ir, these ohuna are invaluable companions when scouting new horizons for the Dragonscale Expedition.

mounts.name: Duskwing Ohuna
mounts.description: If you look to the night sky and see the clouds whisk by don't panic. It may just be the illusive Duskwing Ohuna.

mounts.name: Zenet Hatchling
mounts.description: The hardest winds begin with a gust and a flap.

mounts.name: Temperamental Skyclaw
mounts.description: Slyverns are rarely comfortable acting as mounts. Only those willing to feed their gluttonous appetites and keep a careful eye on them should attempt to ride.

mounts.name: Frostbrood Proto-Wyrm
mounts.description: The same magic of undeath that raised the Frostbrood into the Lich King's service has infused this primal wyrm. Its loyalty and ferocity now serve those who defend Azeroth.

mounts.name: Hailstorm Armoredon
mounts.description: Born in the middle of an ice storm, this armoredon prefers its meals partially frozen.

mounts.name: Crimson Vorquin
mounts.description: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Sapphire Vorquin
mounts.description: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Bronze Vorquin
mounts.description: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Obsidian Vorquin
mounts.description: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Vicious Sabertooth
mounts.description: The elite Alliance forces that use these sabertooth mounts use a battle cry that translates from Darnassian as "here kitty kitty".

mounts.name: Vicious Sabertooth
mounts.description: The elite Horde forces that use these sabertooth mounts use a battle cry that translates from Thalassian as "pspspspsps".

mounts.name: Wondrous Wavewhisker
mounts.description: They say one of these magical fish is born when a fisherfolk dreams of the one that got away... and grows bigger with each retelling of the tale.

mounts.name: Rocket Shredder 9001
mounts.description: The salesgoblin always tells people about the RS-9001's huge variety of attachments, but somehow neglects to mention that you never get to pick the attachments it'll have when you mount up.

mounts.name: Gleaming Moonbeast
mounts.description: Armored in glistening silver, these devoted mounts are said to be a blessing from Elune herself.

mounts.name: Black-Furred Bakar
mounts.description: Such a good boy. Or girl. It's hard to tell sometimes. Always good though.

mounts.name: Inferno Armoredon
mounts.description: Its tail smells like campfire but its breath smells like brimstone.

mounts.name: Tarecgosa's Visage
mounts.description: "Farewell, Tarecgosa. A dear sister, hero, student, and teacher. Though blood does not bind us, you will always be family. May your soul find its place soaring among the stars."

mounts.name: Big Slick in the City
mounts.description: Big heart, big dreams, Big Slick.

mounts.name: Igneous Shalewing
mounts.description: You'd be forgiven for mistaking this creature for a flying volcanic rock. Because to some extent, it is.

mounts.name: Cobalt Shalewing
mounts.description: Brood of Karokta, raised in the underlight of Zaralek Cavern.

mounts.name: Calescent Shalewing
mounts.description: A shalewing born in the wake of Fyrakk's destructive breach. Cursed by his primal flame, its temperature slowly but constantly rises. It must immerse itself in water to cool off periodically, lest its own heat smother it.

mounts.name: Shadowflame Shalewing
mounts.description: Born from the magma, its carapace was originally molten blobs cooled to form dark-colored volcanic rock. Being imbued by shadowflame has only solidified its unbreakable nature.

mounts.name: Cataloged Shalewing
mounts.description: The first instance of a flaming shalewing ever discovered. Nine out of ten researchers agree: it's hot!

mounts.name: Boulder Hauler
mounts.description: These shalewings have been specially trained to carry large amounts of Barter Boulders for the niffen's bartering activities.

mounts.name: Sandy Shalewing
mounts.description: The patterns on the wings of that creature resemble sand flowing through an hourglass. One could gaze upon them for ages...

mounts.name: Morsel Sniffer
mounts.description: A breed of shalewings trained by the niffen to find the deepest of morsels.

mounts.name: Obsidian Gladiator's Slitherdrake
mounts.description: This mischievous drake enjoys flying through geysers and volcanic plumes.

mounts.name: Vicious War Snail
mounts.description: The Alliance uses these ravenous snail mounts to traverse over any obstacle in battlefields.

mounts.name: Vicious War Snail
mounts.description: The Horde uses these ravenous snail mounts to traverse over any obstacle in battlefields.

mounts.name: Felcrystal Scorpion
mounts.description: The results of a fel infusion experiment with one of Skorpyron's offspring.

mounts.name: Grotto Netherwing Drake
mounts.description: After traveling to Outland and back, it's only natural these drakes seek out new skies.

mounts.name: Highland Drake
mounts.description: The drakes of Azure Span follow a strict personal code of honor as they explore the isles anew.

mounts.name: Scarlet Pterrordax
mounts.description: This pterrordax was so eager to take to the skies that its handler couldn't finish training it.

mounts.name: Harbor Gryphon
mounts.description: This gryphon was the runt of its pride, left behind when its brethren were sent for training. Today, however, it is ready to prove its worth.

mounts.name: Valiance
mounts.description: Most undead steeds have their riders chosen for them. Valiance, on the other hand, chooses its own rider.

mounts.name: White War Wolf
mounts.description: Can a wolf's hunger ever be satiated? These lupine brutes seek and devour the enemies of the Horde.

mounts.name: Ravenous Black Gryphon
mounts.description: War corrupted these once-proud creatures. The susurration of their wings now whispers omens of imminent demise.

mounts.name: Gold-Toed Albatross
mounts.description: Soaring from a distant timeway, this never-before-seen avian variant was born in a world of order.

mounts.name: Felstorm Dragon
mounts.description: The Burning Legion defeated dragons in a distant timeway. These foul fel wyrms chose corruption and servitude over destruction.

mounts.name: Sulfur Hound
mounts.description: The Black Empire subjugated these humbled and hateful hounds. Utterly obedient, they still serve the strong.

mounts.name: Perfected Juggernaut
mounts.description: Perfection, like beauty, is in the eye of the beholder. But eyesight can be surgically enhanced.

mounts.name: Scourgebound Vanquisher
mounts.description: Once bound in service to the Scourge, these undead dragons exist only to spread death, disease, and destruction.

mounts.name: Royal Swarmer
mounts.description: These drones will swarm anyone who dares approach their queen uninvited.

mounts.name: Ancestral Clefthoof
mounts.description: This clefthoof has seen ages pass, witnessing everything and patiently teaching many to ride.

mounts.name: Renewed Proto-Drake
mounts.description: As the isles awaken, these proto-drakes answer the call to soar the skies alongside mortals.

mounts.name: Windborne Velocidrake
mounts.description: The long talons of the velocidrake give it an edge on the plains.

mounts.name: Cliffside Wylderdrake
mounts.description: Often roosting along the steep cliff faces of Thaldraszus, they're swift to the skies in times of danger.

mounts.name: Winding Slitherdrake
mounts.description: These drakes feel at home in the depths of the earth and the far reaches of the sky.

mounts.name: Algarian Stormrider
mounts.description: Flying true even in the harshest conditions, this lightning-infused rook was trained to soar through the skies of the Isle of Dorn and into the depths below.

mounts.name: Pattie
mounts.description: Preservationist Kathos encountered Pattie on her first assignment to Vol'dun. Pattie developed an affinity to Preservationist work but is eager to delve deeper, helping adventurers in their sleuthing.

mounts.name: Auspicious Arborwyrm
mounts.description: Sprouting to life only once every sixty years, this living wooden dragon combines the patience of a tree and the grace of a dragon in flight.

mounts.name: Ginormous Grrloc
mounts.description: It's the second biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Azure Worldchiller
mounts.description: In the corners of Azeroth, stories are told of a dreaded dragon who swept a pall of torment over the land. In some versions of this story, his fiery presence brought cataclysmic death and destruction worldwide. In other versions, he is blue.

mounts.name: Eve's Ghastly Rider
mounts.description: The preferred transportation of the Fenlow family (especially during Hallow's End).

mounts.name: Verdant Armoredon
mounts.description: The gnarled horns of this armoredon are far stronger than bone.

mounts.name: Blossoming Dreamstag
mounts.description: The pelts of young dreamstags flower with the vibrant colors of the dream.

mounts.name: Suntouched Dreamstag
mounts.description: The sun's radiant energy nurtures these dreamstags, helping them rapidly reach maturity.

mounts.name: Rekindled Dreamstag
mounts.description: Ashes of fallen leaves are fertile soil for dreamstags to arise from.

mounts.name: Lunar Dreamstag
mounts.description: The moon's pale light is reflected in the pelt of these elusive nocturnal creatures.

mounts.name: Runebound Firelord
mounts.description: By fire be purged the obstacles in your path!

mounts.name: Mimiron's Jumpjets
mounts.description: Created as a prototype by Mimiron. The pieces were stolen from his workshop, sold, and lost to time. That is until now..

mounts.name: Shadow Dusk Dreamsaber
mounts.description: A dreamsaber strikes quickly from the shadows, capturing small animals and slipping back into darkness without a sound. The lucky few who have seen a feeding dreamsaber can see them revel in lazily toying with their prey before beginning their meal.

mounts.name: Winter Night Dreamsaber
mounts.description: These nocturnal dreamsabers carry the chill of winter with them and will often hibernate for days on end if not otherwise awoken.

mounts.name: Evening Sun Dreamsaber
mounts.description: These dreamsabers are ferocious in battle, yet lethargic and often found lazily outstretched upon open fields. After soaking in the warmth of daylight, their flame flares that much brighter.

mounts.name: Morning Flourish Dreamsaber
mounts.description: Known for the lavish energy that emanates from them, these sabers are notorious tricksters. Their roar scatters the early birds that wake them.

mounts.name: Anu'relos, Flame's Guidance
mounts.description: Though her feathers flicker with flame's destructive potential, they do not scorch, but simply radiate a comfortable heat.

mounts.name: Vicious Moonbeast
mounts.description: Unlike most of its kind, this moonbeast has a taste for Horde blood and an affinity for the color blue.

mounts.name: Vicious Moonbeast
mounts.description: Unlike most of its kind, this moonbeast has a taste for Alliance blood and an affinity for the color red.

mounts.name: Draconic Gladiator's Drake
mounts.description: Its wings darken the skies with the shadow of conquest.

mounts.name: Brown-Furred Spiky Bakar
mounts.description: Such a good boy. Or girl. It's hard to tell sometimes. Always good though.

mounts.name: Taivan
mounts.description: You don't have to be what the world expects you to be. Be who Taivan knows you *can* be.

mounts.name: Flourishing Whimsydrake
mounts.description: These playful protectors of the Emerald Dream may be larger than their faerie dragon relatives, but they are no less mischievous.

mounts.name: Verdant Gladiator's Slitherdrake
mounts.description: This drake visited many heroes in their dreams before joining your cause.

mounts.name: Springtide Dreamtalon
mounts.description: Surging with the kind of energy and enthusiasm that can make anyone envious.

mounts.name: Ochre Dreamtalon
mounts.description: Playful dreamtalons often decorate themselves in a myriad of colors that only autumn offers.

mounts.name: Snowfluff Dreamtalon
mounts.description: As lighthearted and gentle as the snow, they can bounce from one snowdrift to the next without leaving a print.

mounts.name: Delugen
mounts.description: Imagine being so engrossed by a dream that it feels real; some might even call it a delusion.

mounts.name: Talont
mounts.description: Some daydreams are filled with wondrous possibilities, but shatter when reminded of reality's limitations. Some dreams are not so burdened, even when they carry a rider.

mounts.name: Stargrazer
mounts.description: One can't help but think what it might feel like to pluck the stars from their fixture in the sky. Perhaps, Stargrazer will show us how someday.

mounts.name: Crimson Glimmerfur
mounts.description: Gilnean legend states this red-and-white fox only crosses the Winter Veil during one season.

mounts.name: Mammyth
mounts.description: In the Dream, sometimes the myth is more real than its basis.

mounts.name: Imagiwing
mounts.description: There's nothing more beautiful than watching your imagination take flight.

mounts.name: Salatrancer
mounts.description: While most salamanthers' attention jumps freely from one attraction to the next, this one enjoys long periods of deep observation.

mounts.name: Heartseeker Mana Ray
mounts.description: Someone once told this mana ray it was adorable. It has been pursuing that positive feeling ever since.

mounts.name: Jeweled Copper Scarab
mounts.description: The rulers of desert kingdoms would attune crystals to their personal mounts for quick summoning.

mounts.name: Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle
mounts.description: This demonic machine was designed by Chief Engineer Ulzik as an experiment in cross-dimensional traversal. Despite many deaths during testing, Ulzik remained confident that this vehicle would reveal secrets of the universe previously unknowable.

mounts.name: Golden Regal Scarab
mounts.description: Plated with gold and socketed with emeralds, this scarab is fit to fly royalty in style.

mounts.name: Jeweled Sapphire Scarab
mounts.description: Begifted to a young Tol'vir Princess, this ornate jeweled statue was brought to life by the Gemseers of Ramkahen.

mounts.name: Jeweled Jade Scarab
mounts.description: The razor-thin wings of this scarab are well-protected by a gleaming, yet indestructible jade-carved carapace.

mounts.name: Hateforged Blazecycle
mounts.description: This sweet deathcycle lets you go on your very own burning rubber crusade!

mounts.name: Voidfire Deathcycle
mounts.description: The prized possession of Haymar the devout. Unclear if he would be anything if not for his epic void bike. Formerly assigned to patrolling the streets of Stormwind after its fall.

mounts.name: Gilnean Prowler
mounts.description: A scrupulous breed of prowlers whose ferocity can only be matched by that of the worgen. These decisive creatures embody discipline and a controlled viciousness that even the worgen have come to admire.

mounts.name: Grotto Netherwing Drake
mounts.description: After traveling to Outland and back, it's only natural these drakes seek out new skies.

mounts.name: Flourishing Whimsydrake
mounts.description: These playful protectors of the Emerald Dream may be larger than their faerie dragon relatives, but they are no less mischievous.

mounts.name: Fur-endship Fox
mounts.description: These magical creatures thrive on love and friendship.

mounts.name: Soaring Sky Fox
mounts.description: Take to the sky on the most loyal and loving fox on Azeroth.

mounts.name: Twilight Sky Prowler
mounts.description: Dubbed the midnight trickster by some, many a couple point to him as the reason their paths crossed in the night.

mounts.name: Compass Rose
mounts.description: Pried from a giant Hearthstone game box.

mounts.name: Noble Flying Carpet
mounts.description: Mages celebrating Noblegarden turned their ordinary festive decor into floating spectacles, only to have them stolen by an angry druid.

mounts.name: Majestic Azure Peafowl
mounts.description: The peafowl is renowned for its stunning colors and plumage.

mounts.name: Brilliant Sunburst Peafowl
mounts.description: With this bird, feathers will never be out of style.

mounts.name: Clayscale Hornstrider
mounts.description: Named for their dusty-red appearance, clayscale hornstriders can be found tearing across the muddy hills of the Ohn'ahran Plains.

mounts.name: Savage Blue Battle Turtle
mounts.description: Don't feel blue chasing your foes, you've got cannons. Nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Infinite Armoredon
mounts.description: Even among the armoredon, the possibilities for the future are infinite.

mounts.name: Vicious Dreamtalon
mounts.description: This feline beast's preferred prey is the Horde.

mounts.name: Vicious Dreamtalon
mounts.description: This feline beast's preferred prey is the Alliance.

mounts.name: Golden Discus
mounts.description: An ancient mogu artifact awarded to those who are deeply committed to forms of currency.

mounts.name: Mogu Hazeblazer
mounts.description: This ancient mogu artifact controls ambient fog to enable levitation.

mounts.name: Sky Surfer
mounts.description: An ancient mogu artifact awarded to those who are deeply committed to the skies.

mounts.name: Daystorm Windsteed
mounts.description: It is said that when lightning strikes the sun, a gleaming beast in red armor would emerge from the heavens. The Daystorm Windsteed has never heard of these legends and has been here the entire time.

mounts.name: Forest Windsteed
mounts.description: The fur of this Windsteed is not only colored to match its woodland home, but also usually contains bits of bark and leaves.

mounts.name: Dashing Windsteed
mounts.description: Windsteeds are incredibly gentle and easy to train... if you can catch one.

mounts.name: Feathered Windsurfer
mounts.description: "Check the current windspeed and elevation before mounting. Avoid trees and other tall objects. Damaged kites are ineligible for return or refund." - Windsurfer's Instruction Manual

mounts.name: Guardian Quilen
mounts.description: When Quan the Relentless fell in battle, his loyal hounds waited for his return. Millenia later, they remain patient.

mounts.name: Marble Quilen
mounts.description: Created by a mogu sorcerer who breathed life into their favorite pet rock.

mounts.name: Gilded Riding Crane
mounts.description: It is said that an emperor once paid a large sum for a golden crane. Upon discovering that the crane was only colored like that of the precious metal, he hid with shame in his bedchambers for a week.

mounts.name: Pale Riding Crane
mounts.description: I looked, and behold, a pale... crane?

mounts.name: Rose Riding Crane
mounts.description: This brightly-colored bird is often confused with a flamingo or marabou.

mounts.name: Silver Riding Crane
mounts.description: This tall bird is one of the most graceful and elegant cranes, slightly moreso than the Bronze Crane but less than the Golden Crane.

mounts.name: Luxurious Riding Crane
mounts.description: A majestic bird, but a rather picky eater.

mounts.name: Tropical Riding Crane
mounts.description: This Jade Forest native uses its coloration as camouflage.

mounts.name: Snowy Riding Goat
mounts.description: The Kun-Lai Summit mountain goats are known for climbing even the highest peaks in search of kafa beans and salt licks.

mounts.name: Little Red Riding Goat
mounts.description: What this goat lacks in size, it makes up for in stubbornness.

mounts.name: Bloody Skyscreamer
mounts.description: This dinosaur still harbors the rage of its ancestors from the Zandalari Invasion.

mounts.name: Night Pterrorwing
mounts.description: Scholars interpret this creature's awful screeching as "fear me, I am the night!"

mounts.name: Jade Pterrordax
mounts.description: This favored mount of the Zandalari is a great singer, or so it thinks.

mounts.name: Cobalt Juggernaut
mounts.description: What started as a rideable mining and logging machine devolved quickly into chaos when engineers asked themselves if they could make it any cooler.

mounts.name: Fel Iron Juggernaut
mounts.description: This war machine was stolen from a timeline in which Garrosh Hellscream joined the Burning Legion. Suffice it to say, there is not much left of that timeline.

mounts.name: Purple Shado-Pan Riding Tiger
mounts.description: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Riverwalker Mushan
mounts.description: The Mushan is a voracious beast. Though it can be tamed, it will demand a second, third, and even fourth breakfast every day.

mounts.name: Palehide Mushan Beast
mounts.description: The Palehide Mushan is the tastiest of Mushan beasts, but it hates being reminded of that fact.

mounts.name: Polly Roger
mounts.description: The scourge of the slightly-northeastern seas, giant parrots like Polly can live for up to 2000 years. What a wonderful curse on your next of kin.

mounts.name: Voyaging Wilderling
mounts.description: These playful visitors from another realm thrive while traveling to new lands with new friends.

mounts.name: Zovaal's Soul Eater
mounts.description: "Was I a good boy?" the soul asked Zovaal. "No. I'm told you were the worst."

mounts.name: Remembered Golden Gryphon
mounts.description: They love lions in Stormwind, and the gryphon is half lion. This is why these creatures are an air travel staple throughout the Alliance.

mounts.name: Remembered Wind Rider
mounts.description: Hundreds of battles across a dozen campaigns have been fought and won on the backs of these honored creatures.

mounts.name: Amber Pterrordax
mounts.description: The Pterrordax could and would eat you in seconds. Are you sure sitting on its back is a good idea?

mounts.name: Stonevault Mechsuit
mounts.description: Metal once ruined, restored to life by scrap and song.

mounts.name: Charming Courier
mounts.description: Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays these charming couriers from the swift completion of their appointed rounds.

mounts.name: August Phoenix
mounts.description: The magnificent August Phoenixes are blessed by Chi-Ji to fill the hearts of riders with wonder and hope for the future.

mounts.name: Astral Emperor's Serpent
mounts.description: After the unburdened Emperor Shaohao gave his final breath to protect his people, a golden serpent descended from the heavens to alight the emperor's spirit to the peaks of Kun-Lai Summit.

mounts.name: Delver's Dirigible
mounts.description: This aircraft will help you delve straight into adventure, wherever it may be!

mounts.name: Kickin' Kezan Waveshredder
mounts.description:
If everybody had an ocean, they'd go surfing with this sweet waveshredder. But in the case of not having an ocean, you can surf the skies!
Hang 8!

mounts.name: Smoldering Cinderbee
mounts.description: A somewhat surprising choice of mount, the Council of Dornogal assures you riding it is safe. Mostly.

mounts.name: Vicious Skyflayer
mounts.description: This creature hungers for battle with the contemptible Alliance.

mounts.name: Pearlescent Goblin Wave Shredder
mounts.description: Surf the shores of Stranglethorn in style!

mounts.name: Crowd Pummeler 2-30
mounts.description: Guaranteed to knock the teeth out from your enemies with a single punch!

mounts.name: Machine Defense Unit 1-11
mounts.description: One of many such mechsuits designed to guard the Machine. After years of faithful service it is no longer suited for combat. It does make for an impressive conveyance, though.

mounts.name: Elder Glowmite
mounts.description: Glowmites slowly grow larger as they age. This one has lived a long, full life.

mounts.name: Cyan Glowmite
mounts.description: Glowmites are well-known in the Ringing Deeps for making surprisingly sturdy mounts. This specimen produces a soft cyan glow that kobolds find especially relaxing.

mounts.name: Soaring Meaderbee
mounts.description: This humble bee dreams of open skies. Whether or not an adventurer is along for the ride is of no consequence to it.

mounts.name: Raging Cinderbee
mounts.description: Temper as hot as its flames, this breed of cinderbee can only be tamed by those who share its insatiable penchant for violence.

mounts.name: Widow's Undercrawler
mounts.description: Surface-dwelling children often profess desires for a pony or wolf of their own upon reaching certain milestones of age. A young Widow Arak'nai had similar ambitions, though her tastes would likely be considered eclectic by some standards.

mounts.name: Heritage Undercrawler
mounts.description: Arachnid husbandry is a time-honored tradition amongst the Heritage Forces. Though most specimens are used for transport labor or raised to serve as shock troops, the finest examples of their brood are occasionally trained as parade mounts.

mounts.name: Royal Court Undercrawler
mounts.description: Patents of lineage are used to demarcate the history and value of thoroughbred undercrawlers in Kaheti high society. This practice can prove somewhat difficult when said undercrawlers are prone to the sudden consumption of their record-keepers.

mounts.name: Alunira
mounts.description: For so long, the very embodiment of the clouds laid trapped atop a mountain of lightning. And at last, I can feel the wind at my back once again.

mounts.name: Aquamarine Swarmite
mounts.description: While it's not exactly common, the representatives of the Severed Threads assure you that swarmites are more than capable of carrying your weight if you choose to ride it.

mounts.name: Nesting Swarmite
mounts.description: Burrowers by nature they often lurk in small animal warrens when laying eggs or lying in wait to surprise larger prey.

mounts.name: Shadowed Swarmite
mounts.description: Swarmites are a common sight both in the wilds of Azj-Kahet and among the nerubians who have long domesticated them, but that doesn't make them any less dangerous to incautious adventurers.

mounts.name: Swarmite Skyhunter
mounts.description: Typically found in the smallest nooks and crannies of rock ceilings, the swarmite skyhunter is more at home in the air than at rest.

mounts.name: Ferocious Jawcrawler
mounts.description: This particularly large jawcrawler is the perfect size to make a mount... just keep your hands and feet clear of its mouth.

mounts.name: Underlight Shorestalker
mounts.description: Aid your deep sea charger in its hunt for prey along the ocean floors.

mounts.name: Underlight Corrupted Behemoth
mounts.description: The light from the saddle helps attract prey to this corrupted behemoth.

mounts.name: Shadow of Doubt
mounts.description: Manifesting after Xal'atath's disappearance, this shadow's very existence begs the question: Were her schemes truly thwarted? Or have we just played deeper into her hands?

mounts.name: Shackled Shadow
mounts.description: Who would have guessed that a shadow elemental would make for such a comfortable ride?

mounts.name: Beledar's Spawn
mounts.description: Through the Sacred Flame, whispers of dark carry you to battle.

mounts.name: Vermillion Imperial Lynx
mounts.description: Imperial lynxes are considered to be an Arathi's greatest companion, both on and off the battlefield. Sadly, this lynx's previous owner died in battle.

mounts.name: Dauntless Imperial Lynx
mounts.description: This lynx's barding has had most of its insignia ripped off. The one remaining tag reads, "Dauntless".

mounts.name: Kor'kron Warsaber
mounts.description: Finding a litter of nightsaber kittens, a squad of Kor'kron Outriders trained them into a formidable pack of deadly mounts.

mounts.name: Blackrock Warsaber
