mounts.description: Finding a litter of nightsaber kittens, a squad of Blackrock Outriders trained them into a formidable pack of deadly mounts.

mounts.name: Sentinel War Wolf
mounts.description: Captured in a Sentinel raid, the loyalty of the wolf favors the strongest.

mounts.name: Kaldorei War Wolf
mounts.description: Captured in a Kaldorei raid, the loyalty of the wolf favors the strongest.

mounts.name: Wick
mounts.description: Rescued from the ruthless charge of Ol' Waxbeard and the looming threat of The Darkness, now able to nibble on loose wax in peace.

mounts.name: Ol' Mole Rufus
mounts.description: Wiser than words can say and still quick on his feet. He just gets a lil' tired sometimes.

mounts.name: Crimson Mudnose
mounts.description: Frequently used by kobolds as mounts, the Assembly of the Deeps has decided to allow you access to one of their most loyal mudnoses.

mounts.name: Vicious Skyflayer
mounts.description: This creature hungers for battle with the contemptible Horde.

mounts.name: Shale Ramolith
mounts.description: Earthen have long used ramoliths as beasts of burden due to their hardy nature. Shale ramoliths are considered to be friendlier than most others, though that isn't saying much.

mounts.name: Slatestone Ramolith
mounts.description: Earthen ranchers talk often of this creature's resilience and how the rain ricochets off of its lustrous coat.

mounts.name: Forged Gladiator's Fel Bat
mounts.description: Awakened from caves in the battlefield, and armored to the fray.

mounts.name: Sureki Skyrazor
mounts.description: The skyrazor was one of the most vicious abominations to emerge from Queen Ansurek's experiments with the Black Blood of the Old Gods.

mounts.name: Retrained Skyrazor
mounts.description: One of a handful of skyrazors captured by Arathi forces during the Sureki offensive after Queen Ansurek's downfall, this beast has found great use in sniffing out void corruption at home and abroad.

mounts.name: Siesbarg
mounts.description: Poor guy.

mounts.name: Ascendant Skyrazor
mounts.description: Intended for the most devoted of the Sureki elite, these skyrazors were favored by Queen Ansurek for both their cunning and brutality.

mounts.name: Frayfeather Hippogryph
mounts.description: This majestic hippogryph hails from the Frayfeather Highlands of Feralas. Though it previously protected its hatchlings, now it chooses to serve a greater cause.

mounts.name: Amani Hunting Bear
mounts.description: The Amani trolls ride this fierce creature on ceremonial hunts in honor of the bear god Nalorakk.

mounts.name: Ivory Goliathus
mounts.description: These giant beetles spend their lives in the darkest tunnels of Khaz Algar. Though they are deprived even of the faintest glimmer of artificial sunlight, they still thrive.

mounts.name: Savage Ebony Battle Turtle
mounts.description: The cannons are powered by an unquenchable rage to seek out enemies and bring them to justice. Nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith
mounts.description: Beneath the stone surface beats a heart emboldened by order to set this world free from darkness.

mounts.name: Startouched Furline
mounts.description: An early eternal traveler encountered the furline and befriended a pair. Accompanying the traveler back to their domain, these furline kittens were forever changed by living there and accompanying the travelers.

mounts.name: Grizzly Hills Packmaster
mounts.description: Traders quickly found them a very capable ally when facing the dangers of Northrend and beyond. They also learned that the bears of the Grizzly Hills were fiercely loyal. Especially to those who keep Emperor salmon at hand.

mounts.name: Plunderlord's Golden Crocolisk
mounts.description: What is a Plunderlord without a proper display of plunder?

mounts.name: Keg Leg's Radiant Crocolisk
mounts.description: The pirate captain later known as Keg Leg knew the risks when he rode a hungry crocolisk into battle.

mounts.name: Plunderlord's Midnight Crocolisk
mounts.description: Any captain worth their salt knows to have a trustworthy navi-gator.

mounts.name: Diamond Mechsuit
mounts.description: These crystal-powered mechsuits are the epitome of Earthen technology.

mounts.name: Hand of Reshkigaal
mounts.description: Reshkigaal bided her time as her kin each tried their hand at usurping the Banished One. She sought to attack when he was distracted, but the Jailer's spies had been tracking her. With their warning and aid, the Jailer prevailed.

mounts.name: Golden Ashes of Al'ar
mounts.description: The golden Al'ar, beloved pet of Kael'thas Sunstrider, proves that death is merely a setback.

mounts.name: Gigantic Grrloc
mounts.description: It's the third biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Coldflame Tempest
mounts.description: Emerging from the chaos of the early elemental wars on Azeroth, the Coldflame Tempest is a reminder that the chill of a blizzard is eternal.

mounts.name: Harmonious Salutations Bear
mounts.description: Riding this mount fills you with a stillness and peace that is not frequently known to accompany murlocs or bears.

mounts.name: Trader's Gilded Brutosaur
mounts.description: Morten and Killia never realized how much their new trading partnership across faction lines would pay off. That is until the day they were able to purchase this fine creature to aid them in their travels. And of course do it in gilded style.

mounts.name: Crimson Armored Growler
mounts.description: Some Goblins affectionately refer to trained hyenas as 'Growlers.' This one is fond of digging.

mounts.name: Blackwater Bonecrusher
mounts.description: Best keep those bones to yourself if you don't want them crushed.

mounts.name: Darkfuse Chompactor
mounts.description: Considered the Top Dog among Stix's Junkyard Hyenas, it boasts a bite force strong enough to crush whatever - or whoever - Gallywix wants disposed of.

mounts.name: Violet Armored Growler
mounts.description: Smaks knows a thing or two about caring for hyenas. Rule number one: keep your hands away from those teeth!

mounts.name: Flarendo the Furious
mounts.description: Being the VIP of VIPs at the Gallagio has its perks, including the keys to this former King of Carnage. Cutting-edge goblin technology allows him to achieve over 100 yards per gallon!

mounts.name: Thunderdrum Misfire
mounts.description: Recovered from the Cauldron's bleachers during a particularly gruesome clash. When asked if it was a dud, Torq's operator simply replied: 'Probably?'

mounts.name: The Topskimmer Special
mounts.description: Smaks is sure this rocket won't explode mid-flight. Absolutely. Positively. 100%. Sure.

mounts.name: Steamwheedle Supplier
mounts.description: Supplies you with a quick trip, or your enemies with a large explosion!

mounts.name: Innovation Investigator
mounts.description: When the best path to a good idea is going really fast.

mounts.name: Ochre Delivery Rocket
mounts.description: Get packages and passengers from point A to B in style!

mounts.name: Blackwater Shredder Deluxe Mk 2
mounts.description: Best not to ask what happened to Mk 1.

mounts.name: Darkfuse Demolisher
mounts.description: Excellent at making a mess of things. Not so great at cleaning them up.

mounts.name: Personalized Goblin S.C.R.A.P.per
mounts.description: Goblin Shredders have proven time and again to be useful in many applications, such as in logging and transportation. This model has been repurposed for use by S.C.R.A.P..

mounts.name: Venture Co-ordinator
mounts.description: Built to manage any Venture-related operation from the front lines.

mounts.name: Asset Advocator
mounts.description: Assuring others that your assets are exactly where they should be.

mounts.name: Salvaged Goblin Gazillionaire's Flying Machine
mounts.description: Once the prized possession of elite goblin society, this flying machine was sadly relegated to the scrap heap after something bigger, brighter, and more explosive arrived on the market.

mounts.name: Margin Manipulator
mounts.description: Ensuring there is always some marginal distance between you and rock bottom.

mounts.name: Darkfuse Spy-Eye
mounts.description: Perfect for the up-and-comer who wants to climb the ladder by making everyone else's business THEIR business.

mounts.name: Mean Green Flying Machine
mounts.description: Steamwheedle's top engineers claim they invented this work of mechanical genius, while the other cartels copied their plans.

mounts.name: Bilgewater Bombardier
mounts.description: For rapid transport of Cartel trade goods and other highly volatile substances.

mounts.name: Delver's Gob-Trotter
mounts.description: This aircraft will help you delve straight into adventure, if it doesn't explode!

mounts.name: Prized Gladiator's Fel Bat
mounts.description: Awakened from caves in the battlefield, and armored to the fray.

mounts.name: Vicious Electro Eel
mounts.description: These aquatic beasts enjoy torturing the Alliance with their electric shocks.

mounts.name: Vicious Electro Eel
mounts.description: These aquatic beasts enjoy torturing the Horde with their electric shocks.

mounts.name: Unstable Rocket
mounts.description: What it lacks in safety features it more than makes up for in speed and style.  Not for the faint of heart.

mounts.name: Unstable Rocket
mounts.description: What it lacks in safety features it more than makes up for in speed and style.  Not for the faint of heart.

mounts.name: Violet Goblin Shredder
mounts.description: This shredder has been lovingly painted with a non-corrosive paint to ensure a lasting sheen.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Gryphon
mounts.description: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Hippogryph
mounts.description: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Dreadwing
mounts.description: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Wind Rider
mounts.description: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Junkmaestro's Magnetomech
mounts.description: Well-suited for compacting trash into rollable balls. Junkmaestro apocrypha claims these might become worlds of their own if only they could get big enough.

mounts.name: Timbered Sky Snake
mounts.description: A living, breathing, flying work of art.

mounts.name: Enchanted Spellweave Carpet
mounts.description: Dalaran mages have created an elegant spellweave and self-stitch aura to accompany this flying carpet. Allowing anyone to handle any loose threads and fly in style.

mounts.name: Timely Buzzbee
mounts.description: Buzzing through the time punctual as ever, these Buzzbees harvest the errant sands of time and return them safely to the Timeways.

mounts.name: Thrayir, Eyes of the Siren
mounts.description: In a fit of rage and despair, Thrayir conjured a storm that would ravage the land and annihilate Cyrce's enemies. After nearly ten thousand years, the seafury tempest continues to roil as an echo of his power.

mounts.name: Hooktalon
mounts.description: Hooktalon once sailed with the Bloodsail Buccaneers, and later with the Blackwater Raiders, but  he left to see what plunder he could find beyond the high seas.

mounts.name: Astral Gladiator's Fel Bat
mounts.description: Awakened from caves in the battlefield, and armored to the fray.

mounts.name: Lunar Launcher
mounts.description: It's always a festival when you are on the Lunar Launcher.

mounts.name: Love Witch's Sweeper
mounts.description: The original design of the feeling-fueled magic broom series "Motion By Emotion", this ride is sure to get you there in a swiffy!

mounts.name: Silvermoon Sweeper
mounts.description: The Silvermoon color scheme for the "Motion By Emotion" has been a success all across Azeroth.

mounts.name: Twilight Witch's Sweeper
mounts.description: A darker look for the "Motion By Emotion" magic broom series of mounts. Fans of this color know that it looks good regardless of the time of day.

mounts.name: Sky Witch's Sweeper
mounts.description: The sky's the limit when you mount up on this "Motion By Emotion" magic broom model.

mounts.name: The Breaker's Song
mounts.description: 'Tis a rare moment in history when a sailor carves the very monster that left 'em stranded to die upon the bow of their ship. Our lot is a blasphemous and piddly bunch. To think one of us might have the humility to honor such a creature is damn near mad.

mounts.name: Soweezi's Vintage Waveshredder
mounts.description: This pretty lil' thing has a beautiful platinum sheen. It'll take ya sky-high in seconds! You'll be dancing around the sun to your heart's content for the low, low price of ten thousand smackeroonies.

mounts.name: Bronze Goblin Waveshredder
mounts.description: Even cartel employees deserve to have some R&R on occassion.

mounts.name: Jani's Trashpile
mounts.description: One mon's trash be another mon's loa! Hek hek hek...

mounts.name: Meeksi Rufflefur
mounts.description: Rufflefurs are playful, clumsy and obsessed with cleanliness. This is a dangerous combination of traits.

mounts.name: Meeksi Softpaw
mounts.description: Softpaws provide a black tea that is ideal for an early morning jolt or staying awake late into the night.

mounts.name: Meeksi Rollingpaw
mounts.description: Rollingpaws are very proud of their tea bearing duties. They are always willing to provide a warm cup of tea to their travelling companions.

mounts.name: Meeksi Teatuft
mounts.description: Teatufts are known for their aromatic teas. However, their playful nature can result in an excess of spilled tea.

mounts.name: Meeksi Brewthief
mounts.description: Despite their mischievous and playful nature, these creatures make for loyal and dependable travelling companions.

mounts.name: Savage Alabaster Battle Turtle
mounts.description: Wisdom throughout the ages has led to a well-known saying, "Nothing can outrun a cannon."

mounts.name: Prismatic Snapdragon
mounts.description: Chameleonic creatures can oftentimes adapt their cells to match the color of the outside world. This snapdragon adopted this ability, but only to match the contents of their stomach; taking the phrase 'you are what you eat' to a whole new level.

mounts.name: Nightfall Skyreaver
mounts.description: Descending on their prey in the dead of night, the cries of these skyreavers once instilled terror in all the children of Draenor.

mounts.name: Ur'zul Fleshripper
mounts.description: This terrifying ur'zul incorporates its latest victims into itself, creating a nearly unstoppable monster. Good thing you are treating it well, or you might be its next treat.

mounts.name: Broodling of Sinestra
mounts.description: After the fall of the Bastion of Twilight, a few scattered twilight whelps escaped Vexiona's sway. Some of these whelps have allied with mortals and are willing to bear them as riders.

mounts.name: Copper-Maned Quilen
mounts.description: Raised in the stables of the Iron Qon, these mounts are ardently steadfast, never leaving their posts even when they sensed the demise of their masters.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Cloud Serpent
mounts.description: Sha has warped this cloud serpent into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Riding Tiger
mounts.description: Sha has warped this tiger into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Blazing Royal Fire Hawk
mounts.description: Only the most passionate of souls and fiercest of hearts can claim the Blazing Royal Fire Hawk as a mount.

mounts.name: Crimson Shreddertank
mounts.description: Experimental shredder designed for killing rather than harvesting.

mounts.name: Lively Darkmoon Charger
mounts.description: Draped in tattered circus banners, this eerie mount is a perfect blend of shadow and spectacle.

mounts.name: Violet Darkmoon Charger
mounts.description: This steed carries the mystery and magic of the Darkmoon Faire on its back.

mounts.name: The Big G
mounts.description: Doesn't actually seem like anything too special under the hood, but just wait until those goblins next door see you pull up for the next pool party.

mounts.name: Shimmermist Free Runner
mounts.description: Unburdened from the saddle and bit, these valerunners are truly free.

mounts.name: Pearlescent Butterfly
mounts.description: Take to the skies on a glittering, shimmering, pearlescent butterfly.

mounts.name: Ruby Butterfly
mounts.description: The elusive Ruby Butterfly is highly sought after by Twilight Witches.

mounts.name: Spring Butterfly
mounts.description: Take to the skies on a glittering, shimmering, spring butterfly.

mounts.name: Midnight Butterfly
mounts.description: PH

mounts.name: Emerald Snail
mounts.description: This snail protects its treasures with the ferocity of a dragon, but perhaps not the speed.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Gryphon
mounts.description: Abandoned by its trainers the Void-Scarred Gryphon scrounged on any scrap of food that remained, most corrupted by the void. With the void now sustaining them, they only land when their fickle tastes are satisfied by untainted food that they just remember enjoying.

mounts.name: Void-Forged Stallion
mounts.description: Forged just as their shoes once were, these beasts are less horses now and void energy in their likeness.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Pack Mother
mounts.description: Fighting her corrupted handlers this pack mother freed herself and her pups. However, freedom from their handlers did not free them from the void in this lost place. She taught her pups to be even more dangerous beasts, and they now stalk throughout Orgrimmar fetching her food as all compete to survive.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Windrider
mounts.description: When the void energies were released, it drove most windriders feral. They killed each other and their trainers. The gates to their roost were locked by the survivors. Some surviving windriders can still be seen gliding above, but none dare return to their new deadly domain to see what remains.

mounts.name: Ny'alothan Shadow Worm
mounts.description: A remnant of the Black Empire's past, these precursors of the abyss worms are once again resurging with the rise of Ny'alotha.

mounts.name: Corruption of the Aspects
mounts.description: With N'Zoth's triumph, what started with Galakrond comes to fruition. With the Aspects gone, the corruption of their species is complete.

mounts.name: Void-Crystal Panther
mounts.description: Although many precious gems have been corrupted by void energies in horrific visions, Master Jewelcrafters can still utilize them to craft mighty panther steeds.

mounts.name: Spotted Black Riding Goat
mounts.description: One time a farmhand walked by without petting this goat. That's all it took for the goat to make it personal.

mounts.name: Resplendent K'arroc
mounts.description: A technological marvel in the flesh, this K'arroc represents hope for a brighter K'aresh.

mounts.name: Prototype A.S.M.R.
mounts.description: Representing the pinnacle of goblin propaganda technology, Gallywix commissioned the Automatic Sonic Machine Resonator to sway his most stubborn critics.

mounts.name: Enterprising Shreddertank
mounts.description: Optimized shredder designed for maximum shredding efficiency.

mounts.name: Terror of the Wastes
mounts.description: It's not world-devouringly bad, just misunderstood.

mounts.name: Terror of the Night
mounts.description: Don't be deceived by its bright colors, it is capable of sneaking up on anyone (or anything).

mounts.name: Delver's Mana-Skimmer
mounts.description: This aircraft will help you delve straight into adventure, or maybe other dimensions!

mounts.name: Chrono Corsair
mounts.description: Always on the lookout for the next golden opportunity, this Infinite Dragonflight pirate has soared through the timeways to find a crew for the perfect heist.

mounts.name: Radiant Imperial Lynx
mounts.description: The Radiant Imperial Lynx embodies the ongoing strength and courage it takes to chase back the darkness. They hoist us up so that we may hold our torches high for all who seek refuge from the encroaching darkness.

mounts.name: Spring Harvesthog
mounts.description: The Spring Harvesthog is at its most energetic in the early morning. It will spend most of its day snuffling for food or bellowing out calls for other harvesthogs.

mounts.name: Summer Harvesthog
mounts.description: The Summer Harvesthog enjoys laying out in the sun or going for a swim in a clear lake. They are excellent at foraging for food, but need to be coaxed into it.

mounts.name: Winter Harvesthog
mounts.description: Winter Harvesthogs are primarily nocturnal creatures. They are slightly slower than other harvesthogs, but their endurance is unmatched.

mounts.name: Autumn Harvesthog
mounts.description: Autumn Harvesthogs excel in snuffling for food in the cooler months. Their keen sense of smell makes them excellent companions for a forrest forage, but difficult to control in aromatic settings.

mounts.name: Coldflame Cormaera
mounts.description: During the war of the elemental lords, Cormaera were often used as beasts of burden for the Firelord's most loyal lieutenants.

mounts.name: Prophet's Great Raven
mounts.description: As the Prophet, Medivh delivered his missives in the form of a black raven. Although not as impressive as shapeshifting, this bird still carries all the prestige of its namesake.

mounts.name: Felborn Cormaera
mounts.description: Cormaera were an early species on Azeroth that were claimed by elemental lords.

mounts.name: Molten Cormaera
mounts.description: In the earliest days of Azeroth, these elemental predators dominated the inferno-choked skies of Ragnaros's domain.

mounts.name: Lavaborn Cormaera
mounts.description: Under the eye of the elemental lords, many cormaera were twisted by their forces and became loyal mounts and partners.

mounts.name: Archmage's Great Raven
mounts.description: Perhaps a little older and a bit more gray instead of customary darkened midnight, this raven still represents one of the most powerful arcane masters of Azeroth, the Guardian Khadgar.

mounts.name: Tyrannotort
mounts.description: Vinnie Sweets kept this rare, albino turtle a secret, saving until it was time to help promote Dastardly Duos.

mounts.name: Herald of Sa'bak
mounts.description: The Tol'vir tell of the legendary Sa'bak, a great crocolisk believed to have emerged from the sacred valley of Un'Goro crater. Although few have ever seen Sa'bak in the flesh, many believe he was blessed by the Titan Keepers to safeguard the vast waterways of Uldum.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Lynx
mounts.description: Taming lynxes is a practice that the Arathi have honed for years. While the Nightfall cultists remain devoted to their cause, they are still ones for passing that tradition along.

mounts.name: Bloodhunter Fel Bat
mounts.description: A beast from an unknown world within the Twisting Nether, tamed through brutal and relentless will.

mounts.name: Ashplague Fel Bat
mounts.description: Only the mightiest of heroes ride into battle atop this monstrosity borne of fel and undeath.

mounts.name: Wretched Fel Bat
mounts.description: Its bracers seem to be a bit snug.

mounts.name: Umbral K'arroc
mounts.description: A savage K'arroc particularly well-suited to prowling the perpetual twilight of K'aresh.

mounts.name: K'arroc Swiftwing
mounts.description: A gift for services rendered, this K'arroc has seen its share of hazardous flights.

mounts.name: Lavender K'arroc
mounts.description: This particularly belligerent K'arroc's previous master died while investigating Untethered Space. Perhaps it will accept you instead... or maybe not.

mounts.name: The Bone Freezer
mounts.description: Bitter rival to The Bone Melter, this creeper was ousted from their lair near Manaforge Omega after a crushing defeat. It now seeks to learn from the one that dethroned its greatest foe.

mounts.name: Ruby Void Creeper
mounts.description: "Rescued" by the K'aresh Trust for study, this void creeper has turned out to be an incredibly sturdy mount.

mounts.name: Acidic Void Creeper
mounts.description: This creeper has feasted on noxious fumes resulting in its body being infused with powerful acids.

mounts.name: Blue Barry
mounts.description: A particularly rare variant of slateback, "Blue Barry" was previously used as a beast of burden.

mounts.name: Curious Slateback
mounts.description: This curious slateback somehow managed to get itself stuck in a box. How it fit inside is still up in the air.

mounts.name: Lana'thel's Crimson Cascade
mounts.description: The Blood Queen's mastery of the sanguine arts allowed her to conjure a fearsome servant to bear her into battle. Adorned in livery suited to her court, it is masked with a fearsome visage, and adorned with wings and claws to bring to mind its master's wrath.

mounts.name: Voidwing Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Cutting through the skies, it flies with silent wings and eyes that glow with the echo of forgotten stars.

mounts.name: Lightwing Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Radiating warmth and grace, it soars on wings of light.

mounts.name: Unbound Star-Eater
mounts.description: In the void-scarred wake of the All-Devouring and his kith, twisted remnants of distant worlds and forgotten aeons find their way across the Great Dark.

mounts.name: Vicious Void Creeper
mounts.description: Originating from K'aresh, these creatures like to burrow and ambush unsuspecting Horde.

mounts.name: Vicious Void Creeper
mounts.description: Originating from K'aresh, these creatures like to burrow and ambush unsuspecting Alliance.

mounts.name: Grandiose Grrloc
mounts.description: It's the fourth biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Snowy Highmountain Eagle
mounts.description: To find the feather of a snowy eagle in Highmountain is an omen of shifting winds and temperature drops.

mounts.name: Grandmaster's Prophetic Board
mounts.description: The chess event was not to be contained. So Medivh fashioned this conveyance to take it on trips.

mounts.name: Grandmaster's Royal Board
mounts.description: Always moving forward to position yourself above the pawns below.

mounts.name: Forsaken's Grotesque Charger
mounts.description: A corpse is a corpse, of course of course.

mounts.name: Wailing Banshee's Charger
mounts.description: These shadow-graced steeds silently carry the Priests of the Forgotten Shadow through the darkened woods of Tirisfal.

mounts.name: Shaohao's Sage Serpent
mounts.description: The lessons Shaohao learned in life and death and the passion he held for his home have coalesced into this ethereal serpent, a reflection of the Emperor's wisdom.

mounts.name: Moonlit Nightsaber
mounts.description: "Her white glow upon their silvered fur, her bright-blue gaze in their moonlit eyes. Oh, how the moons smile on these creatures." -Mother Kalo'thera, High Priestess of Elune, A Blessing in Hajiri

mounts.name: Ivory Savagemane
mounts.description: According to Raptari legend, during Dazar's first ascent up the slopes of Zandalar, the soon-to-be-King was guided through the darkness by the shimmer of ivory scales and gleaming red eyes.

mounts.name: Slag Basilisk
mounts.description: Originally dwelling deep underground where their diet consisted of obsidian and basalt, the slag basilisks surfaced when their homes were disturbed by the Legion.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Voidlight Surger
mounts.description: Shifting between radiant light and consuming void, it surges through the skies in a dance of balance.

mounts.name: Unarmored Deathtusk Felboar
mounts.description: Wandering the glades of Felwood on a steady diet of cursed truffles and lost travelers. Do not pet.

mounts.name: Pearlescent Krolusk
mounts.description: Introduced as an invasive species to K'aresh, Krolusk have found some use as beasts of burden.

mounts.name: Translocated Gorger
mounts.description: Accidentally transported when the Brokers moved Tazavesh, this gorger has found a new world ripe with potential sources of energy, such as anima beacons...and riders.

mounts.name: Sthaarbs's Last Lunch
mounts.description: When one cosmically invasive threat meets another, sometimes the smaller will end up on the menu of the larger. At least cosmic observers don't always chew their meals.

mounts.name: OC91 Chariot
mounts.description: The OC91 Chariot mechsuit is overcharged with the power of Titans. The enhanced power reportedly increases the reflexes and abilities of the pilot.

mounts.name: Inarius' Charger
mounts.description: A symbol of vengeance throughout all known realms.

mounts.name: Royal Voidwing
mounts.description: A cosmic terror warped and hardened by the cruelties of the Nexus-King, now oathsworn to your service.

mounts.name: Ashes of Belo'ren
mounts.description: One of Al'ar's last clutch, Belo'ren was taken to the Isle of Quel'Danas and raised to defend the Sunwell from any who would threaten it with his very life. It is said that death will never claim him.

mounts.name: Light-Forged Mechsuit
mounts.description: Cooperation between the newly-awakened earthen Ordinants and the smiths of Hallowfall has resulted an improved, light-forged earthen mechsuit.

mounts.name: Dusk Grimlynx
mounts.description: Famously adept at hunting at dusk as the light of dusk blends this grimlynx's foliage with its surroundings.

mounts.name: Void-Forged Overseer
mounts.description: After the Sepulcher of the First Ones was opened, this construct of the First Ones was stolen by the brokers and sold to the ethereals in a transaction at the Veiled Market. Under the ethereals' ingenious modifications, it integrated the mysteries of the Aether, gliding through the air with extraordinary elegance, leaving behind a trail of shimmering stardust.

mounts.name: Fierce Grimlynx
mounts.description: This grimlynx has seen many battles against the creatures in the Rift of Aln.

mounts.name: Rootstalker Grimlynx
mounts.description: With fur to match the deep roots and armor to match the vast foliage, these Grimlynx are equipped to be some of the ultimate hunters of Harandar.

mounts.name: Ivory Grimlynx
mounts.description: Ivory grimlynxes have a strong independent streak. It takes an especially brave Haranir to ride them.

mounts.name: Thunder-Ridged Elekk
mounts.description: Even infusion with demonic magics could not break the spirits of these majestic beasts, and their twisted forms were never integrated into the Legion's service.

mounts.name: Cinder-Seared Elekk
mounts.description: The Burning Legion sought to destroy, steal or corrupt anything that brought joy to the draenei, and the elekks of Draneor were no exception.

mounts.name: Void-Razed Elekk
mounts.description: Their temperament is as wild as the twisted forces that warped their creation and they only serve who they choose.

mounts.name: Legion-Forged Elekk
mounts.description: The Burning Legion envied the draenei's bond with the elekks of Draenor. Many demonic beast-masters warped the breed to serve their needs, but none could control them.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Chilling Charger
mounts.description: Through the air you will fly, on your foes you descend, this charger will carry you to deliver their end.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Ghoulish Charger
mounts.description: Tricks have been played, your enemies beaten, this ghoulish charger awaits a treat, friend.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Burning Charger
mounts.description: The fires blaze on, in the steed's heart and soul, now take to the sky as a sight to behold.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Hallowed Charger
mounts.description: Your future's unknown, with ghosts in your past. With your steed at your side, how long can you last?

mounts.name: Adorned Northeron Gryphon
mounts.description: The elder gryphon riders and high shamans of the Northeron Wildhammer often adorned their gryphons in ornate, feather-clad pieces, indicating their rank and status.

mounts.name: High Shaman's Aerie Gryphon
mounts.description: The ancient Wildhammer shamans who first encountered gryphons believed them to be elemental spirits in mortal form. This encounter would forever imprint on the Wildhammer clan for generations to come.

mounts.name: Cinder-Plumed Highland Gryphon
mounts.description: According to Wildhammer legend, the orange plumage found on gryphons is believed to be a hereditary trait passed down from their elemental ancestry.

mounts.name: Emberwing Sky Guide
mounts.description: "From the foothills of Khaz Modan, we followed its ember-lit wings--a northbound torch across the dark summer sky." - The Pilgrimage of the First Wildsage

mounts.name: Ornery Breezestrider
mounts.description: This talbuk is a stubborn, obstinate mount, even after getting to know its rider. Riders beware.

mounts.name: Scarlet Void Flyer
mounts.description: Driven mad by the void, these winged creatures are a flurry of claws and teeth.

mounts.name: Astral Aurochs
mounts.description: Victory is not a simple matter of strength, but having the wisdom and ability to deliver the strength where it is needed most.

mounts.name: Azure Void Flyer
mounts.description: Twisted by the void, these winged creatures now rule the skies of K'aresh.

mounts.name: Scorching Valor
mounts.description: Some cannot be held back or restrained. Scorching Valor will seek greatness and only serve those who can serve their pursuit.

mounts.name: Brewfest Bomber
mounts.description: Careful not to consume the ammunition.

mounts.name: Kalu'ak Crest-Horn
mounts.description: The tuskarr do not call these Crest-Horn "Kalu'ak" to claim them, but as a warning they will not tolerate any more lost to poachers seeking their unique antlers.

mounts.name: Sharktested Crest-Horn
mounts.description: The Crest-Horn will often be drawn to graze on the plants that grow in the sea. Some have braved the fiercest wildlife there, making them true Kalu'ak.

mounts.name: Floestrider Crest-Horn
mounts.description: The seldom seen native of the Azure Span is considered blessed by the tuskaar of the region.

mounts.name: Cragstepper Crest-Horn
mounts.description: Tuskaar aren't often found on Highmountain, but the crest-horns often come down to the shores to seek rare delicacies in the coastal waters.

mounts.name: Bilebound Ur'zul
mounts.description: This demonic amalgamation was the result of a warlock's experiments in curse-infused alchemy. Whether the experiment was a success or failure depends on who you ask.

mounts.name: Ghastly Ur'zul
mounts.description: A ravenous breed of demon, the ghastly ur'zul tears through withered flesh and bone the way one would graze a salad.

mounts.name: Phase-Lost Slateback
mounts.description: This Slateback got lost wandering into various phases as it followed some ethereals around.

mounts.name: Leystone Basilisk
mounts.description: This beautiful basilisk is often hunted for the magical properties of its organs. Fortunately for the basilisk, its connection to ley lines gives it a prescient sense of approaching predators.

mounts.name: Felslate Basilisk
mounts.description: Once common on the Broken Isles, felslate basilisks have been hunted heavily by miners seeking their precious skins.

mounts.name: Aquamarine Basilisk
mounts.description: Despite their name, aquamarine basilisks feast on a variety of coastal crystals and oceanic rocks.

mounts.name: Illidari Dreadstalker
mounts.description: Despite their taste for flesh and unnatural ability to smell fear, these lesser demons have been dominated by the Illidari as one would tame a hunting companion.

mounts.name: Illidari Blightstalker
mounts.description: These demons devour plague and relish in decay. Who thought it would be a good idea to ride them?

mounts.name: Highland Elderhorn
mounts.description: The hide of a highland elderhorn is incredibly thick. Never in recorded history has a highland elderhorn even blinked in response to insults thrown at them.

mounts.name: Treetop Highmountain Eagle
mounts.description: The majestic eagle is a symbol of pride for the Highmountain tribes. This great beast's ability to carry tauren on their backs speaks to the sheer strength and size of the creatures of Highmountain.

mounts.name: Arcberry Manasaber
mounts.description: Named for their resemblance to the bright berries made into arcwine, these proud cats have a keen awareness of the ley lines that travel beneath them.

mounts.name: Fel-Scarred Mana Ray
mounts.description: Surviving on Argus is not an easy task. Its leathery hide scarred by fel corruption, this mana ray is prone to fits of aggression, moreso than usual.

mounts.name: Bloodtooth Mana Ray
mounts.description: The shattering of Argus drove this breed of mana ray to bloodthirst. It now subsists on the corrupted blood of any creatures it can sink its many teeth into.

mounts.name: Albino Mana Ray
mounts.description: The shattering of Argus caused the mana rays to mutate and adapt to their surroundings. Some of them abandoned their pigments in favor of strengthening their senses.

mounts.name: Luminous Mana Ray
mounts.description: Mana rays can emit a bright glow to lure in prey.

mounts.name: Twilight Courser
mounts.description: To evade predators, this courser dims its horn while hiding and flashes with dazzling radiance when provoked.

mounts.name: Golden Sunrunner
mounts.description: This free spirit enjoys long trots on the beach and frolicking through varicolored floral fields.

mounts.name: Turquoise Courser
mounts.description: Named for its uniquely colored eyes that seem to pierce your soul, the turquoise courser shows more intelligence than her dreamrunner cousins and is known to be an excellent judge of character.

mounts.name: Gloomdark Nightmare
mounts.description: Touched by the Emerald Nightmare, this creature's presence in one's dreams is an omen of misfortune. To see one while awake portends absolute catastrophe.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Triumph
mounts.description: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of bold conquest.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Bloodshed
mounts.description: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of eternal strife.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Plague
mounts.description: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of sickness and suffering.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Oblivion
mounts.description: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of scarcity and death.

mounts.name: Longhorned Sable Talbuk
mounts.description: The talbuks of Argus have grown long, coarse fur of brilliant colors that reflects the hues of their broken planet.

mounts.name: Garnet Ruinstrider
mounts.description: Outfitted with sturdy barding, Argussian ruinstriders fearlessly carry their riders across the broken wastes of Argus and beyond.

mounts.name: Longhorned Bleakhoof Talbuk
mounts.description: Scarred by the chaos wrought by decades of conflict, this fel-infused steed is a perfect match for an intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Longhorned Argussian Talbuk
mounts.description: Few talbuks managed to remain unscathed despite the Legion's exploitation of their homeworld. Their tenacity is befitting of a noble steed.

mounts.name: Longhorned Beryl Talbuk
mounts.description: This wild talbuk found among the ruins of Argus has survived and persevered through decades of strife.

mounts.name: Amani Sunfeather
mounts.description: Born of Abundance and the forest's renewal, these eagles gleam in the setting sun, a living sign of the Amani's rekindled strength.

mounts.name: Amani Windcaller
mounts.description: Swift as the storm and sharp as lightning, these sacred eagles bear the mark of Akil'zon, carrying their riders on the winds of her blessing.

mounts.name: Highlands Gobbler
mounts.description: Fierce and very large turkeys are now occasionally seen roaming the deep forests of Tirisfal after the blighting during the Fourth War.

mounts.name: Quirky Turkey
mounts.description: This creature might not be majestic but it certainly will turn heads!

mounts.name: Murky Turkey
mounts.description: No one attempted to try and make a meal of this mount.

mounts.name: Prized Turkey
mounts.description: This extra-large turkey not only took first place due to its pristine feathers, but also for its larger-than-average size.

mounts.name: Frostfall Groveglider
mounts.description: These high-flying denizens of Azeroth's tallest trees have developed a thick, silky coat to adapt to even the coldest climates.

mounts.name: Cindertuft Groveglider
mounts.description: Native to Hyjal, these mischievous tree-dwellers underwent a startling transformation when the Firelands made its appearance in the region.

mounts.name: Gloombough Groveglider
mounts.description: The Gloombough not only have uniquely dark coloring, but are entirely nocturnal, making them one of the rarest tree-dwellers to spot in person.

mounts.name: Blossombranch Groveglider
mounts.description: These enchanting grovegliders are known for their coloring, reminiscent of some of Pandaria's treasured blossoming trees.

mounts.name: Chestnut Courser
mounts.description: Coursers make for excellent steeds. Just don't try to dismount from their front.

mounts.name: Brimstone Courser
mounts.description: The flames of a courser's hooves express their affinity for a particular school of magic.

mounts.name: Brilliant Petalwing
mounts.description: This beast glows with a radiance no void could suppress.

mounts.name: Vibrant Petalwing
mounts.description: Filling the skies of Harandar with a striking pink hue, the Vibrant Petalwing attained its noteworthy pigment through the nectar of various flora it consumes.

mounts.name: Cerulean Sporeglider
mounts.description: This sporeglider likes to gently nuzzle its riders.

mounts.name: Ruddy Sporeglider
mounts.description: This sporeglider derived its striking hue from the unique fungus growing around Teldrassil's roots.

mounts.name: (PH) Legion Remix Mount
mounts.description: The talbuks of Argus have grown long, coarse fur of brilliant colors that reflects the hues of their broken planet.

mounts.name: Mechanical Prototype Panther MK-0
mounts.description: When Gadgetzan citizens pried open Gazlowe palace's underground lab, caged beasts' roars were suffocating. Undermine tech fused combat modules onto these panthers, granting superhuman strength and speed. Rustbolt engineers reprogrammed them exclusively for warriors campaigning in K'aresh. Remember to swap modules at the Morphing Forum before deployment.

mounts.name: Steel Prototype Panther MK-0
mounts.description: The first Steel Horde soldiers crossing the Dark Portal captured a ferocious nightsaber. Blackrock artisans armed it with magma armor, transforming it into a combat weapon. Warriors may customize its parts at the Morphing Forum to suit their fighting style and dominate the battlefield.

mounts.name: Starspark Netherdrake
mounts.description: After flying you to the ends of Outland and beyond, the netherwing drake was eventually drawn to the blue skies of Azeroth as well.

mounts.name: Felscorned Vilebrood Vanquisher
mounts.description: This flying amalgamation of the forces of death and fel pierces the skies with a bone-chilling screech.

mounts.name: Slayer's Felscorned Shrieker
mounts.description: Torn from the heavens by only the most cunning of Demon Hunters.

mounts.name: Felscorned Wolfhawk
mounts.description: Scarred by the war across the Broken Isles, this Wolfhawk deserves a good home.

mounts.name: Archmage's Felscorned Disc
mounts.description: Some mages say fel magics are "volatile" or "corruptive" or "forbidden". Some mages are wrong.

mounts.name: Felscorned Grandmaster's Companion
mounts.description: A twisted visage of a beloved companion.

mounts.name: Felscorned Highlord's Charger
mounts.description: This horse has been irreversibly scarred by the Legion's corrupt magics.

mounts.name: High Priest's Felscorned Seeker
mounts.description: This fel-infused feathered friend flaps its wings at a frenetic pace to remain far above the frenzy below.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Felscorned Omen
mounts.description: Your enemies will know fear before their end.

mounts.name: Farseer's Felscorned Tempest
mounts.description: Fel flavored fury.

mounts.name: Felscorned Netherlord's Dreadsteed
mounts.description: Simply oozing with potential.

mounts.name: Felscorned War Wyrm
mounts.description: The heavens tremble in anticipation of your arrival.

mounts.name: Cobalt Phase-Hunter
mounts.description: Due to the otherworldly energies that irradiated Draenor, these creatures can shift through space at will. As such, they are rarely seen... until it is too late.

mounts.name: Calamitous Carrion
mounts.description: Bearing Zul'Aman's fiercest riders, its shadowed wings strike down any who dare resist.

mounts.name: Convalescent Carrion
mounts.description: Circling above the dying and the doomed, its wings herald plague, ruin, and the certainty that nothing left in its shadow will rise again.

mounts.name: Thunderhoof Celestial
mounts.description: After the Thunder King's fall, his lingering thunder merged with the spirit of a white dragon. It strides on azure lightning, clouds swirling in its wake-where tyranny once reigned, now guardian light remains.

mounts.name: Stormgilded Celestial
mounts.description: Gilded in thunder, chosen by destiny. Golden lightning wraps its hooves, piercing the sky like tearing through night. Legends tie it closely to Emperor Shaohao.

mounts.name: Untainted Grove Crawler
mounts.description: Somehow this grove crawler remains untouched by the horrors that overran Fungara Village.

mounts.name: Echo of Aln'sharan
mounts.description: Heed well the song of the Goddess.

mounts.name: Augmented Stormray
mounts.description: Captured from K'aresh and mutated by Charonus, this stormray escaped from Voidscar Arena and has wandered the Voidstorm.

mounts.name: Fiery Dragonhawk
mounts.description: A dragonhawk whose wings shine as brightly as the leaves of its Eversong home.

mounts.name: Peridot Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Peridot dragonhawks are only awarded to those who have performed great deeds in service of Silvermoon.

mounts.name: Umbral Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Cloaked in blackened tones, this Dragonhawk glides with calm precision, its somber coloring lending it an air of quiet distinction.

mounts.name: Crimson Dragonhawk
mounts.description: A strikingly colored Dragonhawk admired across Quel'Thalas, its vivid red wings cutting bright arcs through the skies as it glides with smooth, effortless grace.

mounts.name: Cobalt Dragonhawk
mounts.description: A rare breed of Dragonhawk that soars the Thalassian skies on azure wings after having escaped from the Sunwing Rookery.

mounts.name: Amani Sharptalon
mounts.description: A rare variety of the Amani eagle, Sharptalons strike with terrifying precision and fly with unparalleled grace.

mounts.name: Crimson Silvermoon Hawkstrider
mounts.description: The pride of the Silvermoon Court, these hawkstriders are prized for their vibrant red plumage and purebred elegance.

mounts.name: Cerulean Hawkstrider
mounts.description: A brilliant-plumed hawkstrider that escaped from the Silvermoon stables, who knows where in Eversong it may be hiding?

mounts.name: Duskbrute Harrower
mounts.description: These harrowers are attracted to the constant battle cries and bloodshed across Slayer's Rise.

mounts.name: Contained Stormarion Defender
mounts.description: While often aggressive, some Harrowers can be tamed and taught to aid in defensive military techniques. This Harrower looks over the Stormarion Core to ensure none can breach it.

mounts.name: Preyseeker's Hubris
mounts.description: Larger mana wyrms are sometimes used as mounts by Blood Elves, but are more frequently kept as status symbols.

mounts.name: Preyseeker's Wrath
mounts.description: Mana wyrms that are large and strong enough to support full barding and rider are quite rare and highly prized.

mounts.name: Preyseeker's Nightmare
mounts.description: Golden mana wyrms are an uncommon mutation. Some of Astalor's side experiments have included efforts to increase their population..

mounts.name: Blessed Amani Burrower
mounts.description: A creature blessed by the wilds, it moves with the steadfast spirit and gentle strength the Amani hold sacred.

mounts.name: Giganto Manis
mounts.description: Whispers tell of the Giganto Manis, a titanic creature said to dwell within Azeroth's very veins. Those who claim to have seen it speak of claws vast enough to pierce a dragon's heart, and sharp enough to carve through the finest armor forged by mortal hands.

mounts.name: Witherbark Pango
mounts.description: This rather rambunctious Pango escaped from the Witherbark Tribe after having its armor affixed. Finders keepers!

mounts.name: Amani Blessed Bear
mounts.description: Once symbols of conquest, these war-bears now stride again, reborn through Nalorakk's blessing and the renewed spirit of the Amani.

mounts.name: Ancestral War Bear
mounts.description: Its tread resounds with the memory of ancient warriors, a living symbol of the unwavering ferocity the Amani revere.

mounts.name: Witherbark Warbear Mother
mounts.description: This warbear mother was captured by the Twilight's Blade while protecting her cub. Her continued separation from her cub is only angering her more. Anyone who manages to reunite her with her cub will have her eternal loyalty.

mounts.name: Amani Hex Bear
mounts.description: Tricked into fighting along the Hex, this fierce creature now fights for the Amani tribe, hoping to find its way back into the good graces of Nalorakk.

mounts.name: Relinquished Scarlet Charger
mounts.description: No longer a tool of the Scarlet Crusade, this charger now guides recruits down the path of the Light with renewed purpose.

mounts.name: Hexed Vilefeather Eagle
mounts.description: Once a proud sky-hunter, she now soars on withered wings, her spirit twisted by lingering necromantic curses that seep through every rotting plume and ghostlit eye.

mounts.name: Ravenous Shredclaw
mounts.description: Fast and dependable, Shredclaws were one of the first creatures tamed in the Voidstorm. Their owners learned quickly not to leave them alone with their pets.

mounts.name: Insatiable Shredclaw
mounts.description: The shredclaw has fully embraced the way of the Void: never satisfied, constantly seeking out new strength to dominate and new prey to devour.

mounts.name: Prowling Shredclaw
mounts.description: According to ren'dorei scouts, shredclaws are often seen hunting in packs.

mounts.name: Frenzied Shredclaw
mounts.description: Once a pack member dies, these shredclaws enter a frenzy of rage that not even a hulking ultradon can stop.

mounts.name: Vicious Snaplizard
mounts.description: These creatures are found sneaking through the battlefield and climbing over obstactles, ready to cause trouble for the Alliance.

mounts.name: Vicious Snaplizard
mounts.description: These creatures are found sneaking through the battlefield and climbing over obstactles, ready to cause trouble for the Horde.

mounts.name: Bronze Wilderling
mounts.description: The regal wilderlings twist through the sky, free as the unbound magic that sustains their flight.

mounts.name: Bronze Aquilon
mounts.description: The reliable steeds of Bastion are designed to mirror the proud and noble warriors of the Ascended.

mounts.name: Bronze Corpsefly
mounts.description: It takes a great deal of effort to decorate a corpsefly, but some would say the efforts are worth it.

mounts.name: Bronze Gravewing
mounts.description: While dark and ominous is the preferred aesthetic of those who reside in Revendreth, there are some who still favor gleaming luster.

mounts.name: Galactic Gladiator's Goredrake
mounts.description: Originating from the void, fully armored and ready for combat.

mounts.name: Geargrinder Mk. 11
mounts.description: Undergoes a new iteration each time it explodes!

mounts.name: Skypaw Glimmerfur
mounts.description: A Glimmerfur's coat takes on properties of its environment much like a camouflage. Patterns of bright blue skies and majestic white clouds have earned this glimmerfur the nickname "Skypaw."

mounts.name: Crimson Lupine
mounts.description: Once, the First Ones desired creations with fierce devotion they could mold to their purposes. The lupine of Zerith Mortis are one of their many creations, and those bearing crimson forms are said to be the most powerful of all.

mounts.name: Spectral Hawkstrider
mounts.description: Phalanx Breaker of the Silvermoon Cavalry, this companion of the past ever wills its rider forward.

mounts.name: Spawn of Vyranoth
mounts.description: Vyranoth's brood was decimated by the aspects, yet Vyranoth's actions have brought many of her surviving progeny to follow in her frigid path and aid in Azeroth's defense.

mounts.name: Brawlin' Bruno
mounts.description: Said to be leaner and potentially even meaner than the venerable Bruce. Bruno's legacy is yet to be written.

mounts.name: Ballistic Bronco
mounts.description: Ideal transportation for a Brawler that always hits their mark.

mounts.name: Snowpaw Glimmerfur Prowler
mounts.description: The snowpaw inhabit the frigid afterlives of the Shadowlands, reveling in their frosty environment. Travelers thought lost to the deadly blizzards of Northrend would sometimes miraculously be found alive, proclaiming that they owe their lives to the mysterious foxes that protected them.

mounts.name: Lucent Hawkstrider
mounts.description: A loyal creature of Thalassian nobility, it finds comfort holed up in the Magisters' Terrace.

mounts.name: Emerald Hawkstrider
mounts.description: Its rider died during battle, and so the saddle is passed to you.

mounts.name: Venomous Gladiator's Goredrake
mounts.description: This armored mount makes everyone around you green with envy.

mounts.name: Savage Crimson Battle Turtle
mounts.description: This savage turtle sees red at every turn. Though slow in speed, it is vital to remember that nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Cloudborn Razorwing
mounts.description: A very rare Korthian creature, due to limited cloud cover.

mounts.name: Sanguine Harrower
mounts.description: A brutal aerial predator of the Voidstorm, the Sanguine Harrower makes up for its lack of stealth with a terrifying visage and hunting prowess.

mounts.name: Voidbound Stormray
mounts.description: With its razor-sharp teeth, the Voidbound Stormray look eager to bite you.  It will, but only if you let it.

mounts.name: Lab-Grown Stormray
mounts.description: Through the intensive research in the Void, researchers were able to bring this stormray back to life completely tamed.

mounts.name: Tenebrous Harrower
mounts.description: The fiercest harrowers of Voidstorm are often twisted by the void and bound to Xal'atath's will.

mounts.name: Arboreal Pseudoshell
mounts.description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Cabbage Pseudoshell
mounts.description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Lavender Pseudoshell
mounts.description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Accented Pseudoshell
mounts.description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Fantastical Goblin Waveshredder
mounts.description:
When you're ready for fun you're ready for the Fantastical Goblin Waveshredder. Guaranteed to bring the fun.



*Disclaimer: Fun not guaranteed

mounts.name: Delver's Arcane Golem
mounts.description: Originally intended as a gift for Silvermoon, this construct was lost in transit near the shores of Gnarldor Isle.

mounts.name: Silvermoon's Arcane Defender
mounts.description: A gilded variant of the Arcane Guardian, most often seen guarding the more opulent districts of Silvermoon City.

mounts.name: Elven Arcane Guardian
mounts.description: Sworn defender of the Elven people, animated by arcane power and an unyielding will to protect.

mounts.name: Arcanovoid Construct
mounts.description: The Void's influence is far-reaching and overpowering enough that even an Arcane Guardian can be made to kneel.

mounts.name: Ghastropod
mounts.description: This snail make a deliberate decision to plunge itself into the slime canals of Undercity. It emerged bigger, stronger but not faster than before.

mounts.name: Vicious Snapvine
mounts.description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. This Snapvine is always wanting to see more of the world and be fed.

mounts.name: Ferocious Snapvine
mounts.description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. The fruit from this beast is especially delicious when baked in a pie.

mounts.name: Blooded Snapvine
mounts.description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. The distinct, bold coloring means the creature has eaten recently.

mounts.name: Savage Snapvine
mounts.description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. Why would anyone want to find one of those things, much less ride one? But the fruit is good.

mounts.name: Hypo-Speed X6000
mounts.description: A compilation of nuts, bolts, gears, and treated wood paneling make for an unusually speedy ride.

mounts.name: Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt
mounts.description: Woven together by some of the finest Dalaran mages, this flying quilt is known for its comfort and fluffy pillows.

mounts.name: Gruffy Comfy Flying Quilt
mounts.description: Woven together by some of the grumpiest Dalaran mages, this flying quilt is known for its comfort and fluffy pillows.

mounts.name: Comfy Bel'ameth Flying Quilt
mounts.description: Ainderu Summerleaf's hand-woven quilts are popular among the children of Bel'ameth.

mounts.name: Comfy Silvermoon Flying Quilt
mounts.description: Sempstress Ambershine's enchanted quilts became a must-buy trend for the noble-borne children of Silvermoon City.

mounts.name: Vivacious Chloroceros
mounts.description: Catching a chloroceros mane leaf mid-air is considered a sign of good luck among the Haranir. The more vivacious the leaf, the greater the luck.

mounts.name: Vivid Chloroceros
mounts.description: The healthier the chloroceros, the more vivid the foliage.

mounts.name: Fel Spirehawk
mounts.description: Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into the heart of a fel corrupted sun. Goggles are recommended when you're riding.

mounts.name: Unbound Manawyrm
mounts.description: The turbulant void magics that have gripped the Sunwell are attracting the rare great manawyrms, corrupting them as they feed on the unbound magics.

mounts.name: Anu'shalla, Shadow's Guidance
mounts.description: Her wings cut through the sky like shadows on a moonlit night.

mounts.name: Stoneforged Sentinel
mounts.description: Sometimes the right tool for the job cannot be simply pulled from a shelf. Craftsmen from across Azeroth have developed the Stoneforged Sentinel to address this need, allowing each to create the perfect guardian for the time and place it is used.

mounts.name: Gilnean Iron Charger
mounts.description: This noble horse has seen some battles during the curse uprising.

mounts.name: Gilnean Copper Charger
mounts.description: Carve through the night on this loyal, stalwart steed.

mounts.name: Pyrewood Rebel's Rouncey
mounts.description: After diligent training from riders in both worgen and human forms, these horses will now bear any rider in Gilnean finery.

mounts.name: Gilneas Loyalist's Rouncey
mounts.description: Steadfast and proud, this steed carries its rider with quiet dignity and unyielding resolve.

mounts.name: Blossomback Arboon
mounts.description: Once a common sight in the mountains surrounding the Jade Forest, the arboon's return signals the forest may be healing.

mounts.name: Amberback Arboon
mounts.description: The golden blossoms of the amberback arboon are a sign of its age and wisdom. A rarity among rarities, even seeing one is considered good luck.

mounts.name: Magister's Spell Bee
mounts.description: A few Silvermoon Magisters once dedicated their arcane thesis to the study of infusing local flora with arcane-flecked pollen and the effects it had on pollinator species. To the Grand Magister, it was a success. To Silvermoon's Gardeners, it was not.

mounts.name: Void-Touched Hawkstrider
mounts.description: Almost no beasts are immune to the void's touch. A few of our scouts' hawkstriders have been affected by the void. I have been observing them now for a bit and they are still fit for service. In some ways they are even more fit for the kind of work you are up to. - Sergeant Vornin

mounts.name: Zothwing Darkseeker
mounts.description: Do not let its cloying looks fool you--zothwing darkseekers are a remnant of an ancient Black Empire species. Pay no attention to whispers mentioning "snackies" for your "trusty mount."

mounts.name: Zothwing Deepseeker
mounts.description: A gift of N'Zoth, Zothwing Deepseekers are as at home in the crushing depths of Azeroth's oceans as they are in the bitter cold of the void.

mounts.name: Dusk-Painted Sun Roc
mounts.description: Long ago, the dusk-painted silhouettes of these sun rocs inspired many fireside myths. Their return to Kalimdor has reignited lost stories of these heralds of An'she.

mounts.name: Flame-Painted Sun Roc
mounts.description: In ages past, the sun rocs of Kalimdor were believed to be the messengers of An'she, carrying with them the first flame before dawn and the final light of evenfall.

mounts.name: Golden Ashened Cataclysm
mounts.description: In the corners of Azeroth, stories are told of a dreaded dragon who swept a pall of torment over the land. In some versions of this story, his fiery presence brought cataclysmic death and destruction worldwide. In other versions, he is blue. Still in other versions, he is gold.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Riding Wolf
mounts.description: Sha has warped this wolf into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Luminous Sporeglider
mounts.description: This sporeglider's voracious appetite for luminescent spores has lent it an exquisite glow.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Owl
mounts.description: Sha has warped this owl into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Void-Corrupted Hex Eagle
mounts.description: A vile ritual can give the ritual master great power. It can also give the target of the ritual great power. This can sometimes go well or poorly for the ritual master.

mounts.name: Void-Touched Snapdragon
mounts.description: The snapdragon is a resilient creature and loyal by nature. This has made them preferred companions of the naga. However, their latest ritual has made this snapdragon ready for a new home.

mounts.name: Void-Corrupted Lynx
mounts.description: The Eversong lynxes are known for their curiosity and this one especially. Sneaking into supply stores, and treasure boxes around ritual sites has changed it forever. Anyone who manages to leash it will have a feisty mount on their hands.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Dragonhawk
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Spring Panda
mounts.description: Equipped with bamboo tools, food and a napping cub, the Spring Panda is ready for an amazing adventure.

mounts.name: Blackwater X-TREME Firework Rocket
mounts.description:
"There is no guarantee this rocket will get you where you want to go in one piece.



Warning: Rockets explode!"

mounts.name: Bilgewater X-TREME Firework Rocket
mounts.description: The engineers of Undermine were so preoccupied with whether or not they COULD make a faster rocket, they didn't stop to think if they should.

mounts.name: Sunflare Driftmoth
mounts.description: Although they offer some of the smoothest rides of any mounts in the world, the Sunflare Driftmoth are rare to find in the wild, and rarer still to tame.

mounts.name: Spirit of Tok'jara
mounts.description: Now freed from the curse, the great eagle Tok'jara continues to serve the Amani even through death.

mounts.name: Hearthkeeper's Wandering Caravan
mounts.description: Comfortable as your own home and adventurous as a tortollan trader, the Hearthkeeper's Wandering Caravan will carry you in luxurious style anywhere your travels on Azeroth take you.

mounts.name: Rabbit'ath
mounts.description: The presence of Rabbit'ath brings doom and despair to all who witness. Legend says that in its eyes, you can glimpse the end of all things.

mounts.name: Voidmancer's Starcarver
mounts.description: This pinnacle of Voidmancer transport technology was once a symbol of status and power among high ranking domanaar. After its creator mysteriously vanished, it was viewed as unseemly when used on core worlds gatherings.

mounts.name: Netherforged Nullframe
mounts.description: Assembled by the Lightforged, sundered by the Hal'hadar, and restored by a Technomancer. A matrix of light, void, and arcane swirls within this renewed Warframe.

mounts.name: Badlands Buzzard
mounts.description: The white buzzards are some of the rarest in all the Badlands. Rumor has it that one may even be caught and tamed to fight alongside hunters.

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Eagle
mounts.description: Even the dead need a lift every now and then.

mounts.name: Vicious Lightbloom Boar
mounts.description: Motes of energy surround this mount, occasionally reflecting a ray of light across your vision.

mounts.name: Vicious Lightbloom Boar
mounts.description: Motes of energy surround this mount, occasionally reflecting a ray of light across your vision.

mounts.name: Autumnal Witchwick's Rider
mounts.description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Cerulean Deathwalker
mounts.description: A frozen tide of wailing souls, locked in cerulean ice, grinds onward under the weight of eternal suffering.

mounts.name: Amethyst Mechsuit
mounts.description: Where diamond reflects perfection, amethyst resonates with power.

mounts.name: Blue-Chip Shreddertank
mounts.description: It may not be exciting, but it makes money every time.

mounts.name: Profit-Green Shreddertank
mounts.description: If it's leaking, it's working.

mounts.name: Speculative Shreddertank
mounts.description: The numbers look great if it doesn't explode.

mounts.name: High-Yield Shreddertank
mounts.description: High return. High risk. Non-refundable.

mounts.name: Mossy Witchwick's Rider
mounts.description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Moonlit Witchwick's Rider
mounts.description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Blushing Witchwick's Rider
mounts.description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Carmine Witchwick's Rider
mounts.description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Sea-Dwelling Isle Serpent
mounts.description: This oozing serpent has a taste for fish. As long as you can feed them, they should remain friendly. Should.

mounts.name: Caustic Venomfang
mounts.description: This venomfang's toxins are potent enough to liquidate its prey in seconds.

mounts.name: Crimson Venomfang
mounts.description: A venomfang's most deadly weapon is its terrifying tail, which can mortally envenom its prey with a mere scratch.

mounts.name: Auriferous Venomfang
mounts.description: Its stealth foiled by bright scales, this venomfang lurks among hidden treasure for the next meal.

mounts.name: Apophic Soul Crusher
mounts.description: Once powered by the arcane, now fueled solely by the tortured spirits of the unfaithful.

mounts.name: Primeval Skyfriend
mounts.description: The most vicious elder skyfiends lurk within the confines of the Venomous Abyss, surfacing only to stalk prey across the shores of Atal'Utek before returning to their fetid lairs. This one has become your sky-friend.

mounts.name: Hexflame Reaver
mounts.description: Its glow is a warning: the hunt is already over.

mounts.name: Preyhunter's Fury
mounts.description: You don't follow tracks; you follow the fading green fire.

mounts.name: Tortured Gorger
mounts.description: Both domanaar and ethereals have tried to cage this devourer. Each time they have failed. Now, soaked in the energies of the void, this tormented gorger is ready to unleash havoc.

mounts.name: Sun Festival's Painted Roc
mounts.description: Long ago, this elusive summer roc inspired many legends, many believing them to be descendants of phoenixes. The ancient tauren saw these majestic creatures as living manifestations of An'she's fire.

mounts.name: Corroded Soul Crusher
mounts.description: Aeons passed without leaving a mark upon its arcane frame. It took the corrosive ichor of Ula'Tek to finally erode what eternity could not.

mounts.name: Topaz Skyfang
mounts.description: This elusive wind serpent likes to hide in the forest canopy before stooping down on unsuspecting prey.

mounts.name: Emerald Skyfang
mounts.description: Found patrolling the skies of Atal'Utek, maintaining the peace and a full stomach.

mounts.name: Violet-Backed Skyfang
mounts.description: The wind serpents of Atal'Utek have venomous tails. You can thank Ula'tek for that.

mounts.name: The Writhing Brood
mounts.description: A grotesque conglomerate of serpents, it has yielded to you after witnessing your battle against The Writhing Coil.

mounts.name: Indigo Coiled Horror
mounts.description: Writhes have three distinct temperaments, making them three times as difficult to tame.

mounts.name: Ruby Writhe
mounts.description: Riding on a writhe makes it thrice as nice.

mounts.name: Venomous Coiler
mounts.description: A native of the deadly venom pits within the Vaults of Atal'Utek, this monstrosity poisons the air it slithers past.

mounts.name: Breath of Blight
mounts.description: A sickly haze trails in its wake, poisoning earth, air, and anything foolish enough to pursue it.

mounts.name: Breath of Ruin
mounts.description: Where its shadow falls, even the bravest hear the echo of forgotten wars.

mounts.name: Umbral Ashes
mounts.description: Its flames consume all but the worthy.

mounts.name: Whoofle Bramblewing
mounts.description: Patient and precious, this feathered friend is also just a little warmer than most mounts. Cozy ride, but keeping a close eye on your tailfeathers is recommended.

mounts.name: Crested Ember Leafmimic
mounts.description: This sturdy leafmimic can be found only in the warmest of areas. Its red scales allow it to hide undiscovered in the heated alcoves it prefers.

mounts.name: Crested Aqua Leafmimic
mounts.description: The aqua leafmimic is a rare sight indeed. Found only in the forests of Ashenvale, its darkened scales allow it to hide among the trees and groves undetected.

mounts.name: Crested Verdant Leafmimic
mounts.description: Found primarily in areas with dense vegetation, this leafmimic is rarely spotted due to the natural hues of its scales, allowing it to blend in with its surroundings.

mounts.name: Crested Violet Leafmimic
mounts.description: The violet leafmimic can be found in most dense jungles -- but only if your eyesight is keen. The patterns on their scales allow them to blend in with the vibrant foliage and shadows.

mounts.name: Cerulean Prideclaw
mounts.description: A fierce and loyal mount that will accompany you on all your journeys.

mounts.name: Wintry Witchwick's Rider
mounts.description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion
mounts.description: When it is time to answer the call to adventure, this bear will be ready to take you there.
